row.name: WeilerVR PPE Trainer
row.detailed_description: WeilerVR: PPE Safety Trainer is a complete virtual reality training application centered on personal protective equipment (PPE) and workplace safety. Key Features   Full interactive training scenario – Learn correct PPE procedures in a realistic setting   Hands-on interaction – Grab, equip, and apply protective gear   Physics-based realism – Natural motion and tactile precision   Educational focus – Reinforces awareness and decision-making   Authentic environment – Modeled after real industrial locker rooms Step into a realistic locker room where your task is to prepare a mannequin with the correct protective gear and task-specific gear. The experience emphasizes accuracy, awareness, and safe preparation practices. Physics-based interaction and intuitive VR controls let users naturally engage with each item, reinforcing industrial safety standards. Developed for Weiler Abrasives, this standalone experience demonstrates how VR can enhance training, reduce risk, and reinforce safety culture.
row.short_description: Step into a fully interactive VR locker room and master proper personal protective equipment procedures. Grab, equip, and prepare a mannequin with safety gear in a short but sweet training experience.

row.name: Parasitism
row.detailed_description: Parasitism is a 2D souls-like action game built around real-time Protocol Switching combat. Players can freely switch between four distinct combat protocols (stances) at any moment during battle. Each protocol features its own attack tempo, stamina economy, defensive options, and risk profile. Combat is based on parry timing, guard precision, and risk–reward decision making . To survive, players must read enemy patterns, choose the correct protocol, and manage tempo and resources throughout the fight. Protocol Switching Combat System Switch between four combat protocols in real time Each protocol alters combat rhythm, resource flow, and ability effects “Stance choice = combat strategy” — your decision determines the fight’s outcome ⚔ Refined Soulslike Combat Guard, dodge, and parry timing form the core of battle Hitstop, knockback, and other impact feedback are hand-crafted for tight control feel Mistakes are punished instantly, but every pattern is learnable and fair ⚔ Pattern-Driven Enemy Design Not a stats race—victory comes from reading, reacting, and switching The combat loop itself becomes a learning and growth experience for the player
row.short_description: A 2D soulslike action game built around real-time Protocol Switching. Change stances mid-combat to alter attack tempo and defense options, and counter enemy patterns.

row.name: Good Morning My Darling
row.detailed_description: Description: In this game, you play as Mailey, who is looking to prepare herself some morning tea while waiting for her housemate, Derthan, to return. However, all the tea ingredients have gone missing, nothing is where is should be, and there are puzzles littered throughout the rooms. You will need to carefully inspect her house, look for clues as to where things might be hidden, and solve a variety of puzzles to progress through the game. As you make more progress, Mailey will start to remember some of her forgotten memories, and by interacting with them, you will be able to uncover even more. However, the memories that you will bear witness to may not be the happiest... Features: This game was created by one person, and features an original soundtrack. It contains a variety of different puzzles... And several interesting characters that you talk with and learn more about throughout the game's runtime. There are four different routes by which you can go through the game, affected by in-game choices. You can access a memory world which allows you to move further in the story! There are several different methods in which you can discover new memories, encouraging different approaches on subsequent playthroughs, and increasing replayability. There are many hours of gameplay ahead of you if you're aiming to complete multiple endings. This game contains a multitude of unique visuals, including... A menu visual that changes depending on which ending you got last. This game can be played entirely with just a mouse and keyboard. It contains 8 different endings... And 33 unlockable achievements!
row.short_description: Mailey wakes up and goes to make her morning tea. However, something strange is going on inside her house, and her housemate Derthan is nowhere to be seen. Perhaps, the answer lies somewhere in her memories?
row.notes: This game contains things not intended for all audiences; fantasy violence, unrealistic blood, and scary imagery. It also briefly engages with topics such as self harm, child endangerment, substance abuse, and depression. Discretion is advised.

row.name: Shadow's Grove
row.detailed_description: Shadow’s Grove is an emotionally-driven action adventure game following the journey of Astrid, a young spirit guide struggling to accept the loss of her lifelong companion, Eri. As she navigates the Valley of Souls, Eri’s fading presence becomes invaluable to her as the two rely on one another to uncover new paths and confront powerful spirits. But, the longer Astrid remains in the afterlife, the clearer the truth becomes to her and Eri: that moving forward may mean letting go. In this journey, you’ll guide Astrid through a world brimming with heart and mystery, uncovering the true nature of the afterlife while forging an unbreakable bond with Eri. Traverse a range of hand-crafted, otherworldly environments while carefully shifting between human and wolf form Solve environmental puzzles to forge a path through the malleable fabric of the afterlife Vanquish corrupted spirits using the collaborative power of Astrid’s magic and Eri’s strength I mmerse yourself in the rich, emotional soundtrack that deepens the narrative of loss, connection, and discovery This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Step into the serene yet ever-shifting afterlife on a journey to reunite with your lost wolf companion. Explore surreal environments, solve thought-provoking puzzles, and navigate distorted enemies as you work through the tangled emotions of loss and moving forward.

row.name: Leadstorm Survivors
row.detailed_description: Leadstorm Survivors is a fast, top‑down arena shooter built for short, high‑intensity runs. Kite smart, manage space, and shred swarms while every second pushes the pressure up. Between runs you bank points to permanently upgrade damage and fire rate , then jump back in to chase a bigger score and unlock all 5 arenas . Why it hits: Quick sessions, big dopamine. 1–5 minute runs that escalate fast. Pure skill loop. Tight movement and precise aiming—no fluff, just you vs. the horde. Permanent meta‑progression. Spend banked points on damage and fire‑rate upgrades to push further next time. 5 hand‑crafted arenas. Different layouts that change how you kite and control space. Clean, readable visuals. Bullets and enemies pop so decisions stay sharp at any pace. Score‑chasing focus. Beat your best, climb your own curve, and unlock more maps as you improve. If you love tight controls, fast feedback, and a “one more run” loop you can play on a break, Leadstorm Survivors was made for you.
row.short_description: Fast top‑down arena shooter. Run short, high‑intensity sessions, shoot swarms, bank points between runs to upgrade damage and fire rate, and unlock 5 arenas. Perfect for quick score‑chasing that keeps getting tougher.

row.name: Before I Come In
row.detailed_description: Before I Come In is a narrative-driven interactive storytelling game that blends emotional depth with social impact. Players will embark on two very different journeys, each offering meaningful choices, branching paths, and unique outcomes: • Dennis’ Story Follow Dennis on his path of growth, navigating relationships and personal challenges. Players make impactful decisions and collect six symbolic gems, each unlocking new insights and serving as keys to advance the story. • Tyler’s Story Based on the real-life story of Tyler Clementi, a young Rutgers student whose tragic death brought national attention to issues of privacy, bullying, and LGBTQ+ acceptance. This storyline invites players to step into a powerful narrative where every decision underscores the importance of empathy and courage. Created in collaboration with the Tyler Clementi Foundation, a portion of proceeds will be donated to support their anti-bullying and LGBTQ+ youth empowerment initiatives. Core Features • Interactive storytelling with branching narratives and multiple endings. • Choice-driven gameplay: Your decisions directly shape each character’s journey. • Unique character growth system through symbolic gem collection. • Authentic emotional soundtrack, including recordings of Tyler Clementi’s violin performance, bringing his presence into the experience. • Estimated playtime: 1–2 hours per storyline, designed for replayability. • Social impact focus: A portion of proceeds supports real-world advocacy. This is more than a game — it’s an interactive experience where your choices carry weight, and your presence helps keep Tyler’s memory alive.
row.short_description: A visual novel/block-breaker hybrid. Make choices that shape the story and stats, which affect your projectile strength in the block-breaking mini-game. Follow a young man's journey of growth and sexual self-discovery. 2-4 hours of playtime.

row.name: Hydrodynamics of Hope & Optimism
row.detailed_description: Self-Delusion – A Modern Plague Are you happy in life? Do you sometimes feel dehydrated? Is the glass half-full or half-empty? Are you prone to self-delusion?   Hmm… I see. You are declared the target audience for Hydrodynamics of Hope & Optimism - in short, H2O!   On the topic of water Do not fret, self-delusion is not an incurable condition! One of the best solutions to prevent self-delusion is drinking water! It is extremely important to stay hydrated during your day, as a lack of water could lead to several conditions, such as headaches, stomach-aches, headaches, syphilis, headaches, cancer, headaches, job-loss, and many other problems including headaches. To further illustrate the importance of water, please note that you are composed of approximately 60% of water (70% if you’re a child). Some parts of your body have an even higher percentage of water: your brain, for example, is composed of almost 90% of water (source: me). If it helps, you can therefore see your brain as a jellyfish. With eyes. Yes, I know it doesn’t help. But now, how do you know if you’re self-delusional?   Hydrodynamics of Hope & Optimism Discover the shameful fallacies of your brain by using Hydrodynamics of Hope & Optimism -in short, H2O! With this software, you can be declared sane. Officially sane. How does it work? You will be asked to fill a series of glass halfway. Of course, you will probably fill them a little too much, or a little not enough. Our counselor, TeaTotal, will analyse your glass-filling trends, and then assess your mental state to see if you are sane or self-delusional. No refunds. Do not fear, happiness is within your grasp! Stay hydrated!   What this game features Wait. Is this actually a game? Yes. No. Who cares? If you actually care, the only element of answer the team shall provide is the definition given by Salem, K. and Zimmerman, E. in their 2003 book  Rules of Play: Game Design Fundamentals: ' a game is a system in which players engage in an artificial conflict, defined by rules, that results in a quantifiable outcome.' Now then, the artificial conflict here is the 25 or so glasses to fill  and 20 questions to answer leading you to a quantifiable outcome of  questioning your life choices , although existential doubt should emerge around the 15th glass. And at the end, you get a nice final Hope & Optimism score because god knows ya’ll gamers need a satisfying conclusion. Of course, for the sake of achievement-addicted Steam players, this game features 17 achievements for increased replayability value (wink wink, nudge nudge).   Won't somebody please think of the gameplay? Oh, right. Well, you will use a whopping FOUR buttons  to play this game! Hold space to fill the glasses, only to release it when you think you've reached the halfway point. Press left  or right  when choosing an answer to declare which glass you shall fill. Press enter  to advance in the therapy ( i.e. the dialogues). Technically, you can also use escape to quit the game, but we don't think it counts.
row.short_description: Is the glass half-full or half-empty? What does you answer say about you? Explore your outlook on life by filling glasses with your friend Tea-Total in Hydrodynamics of Hope & Optimism (in short, H2O). But are you ready to hear those answers? Are you reeeeeeeeeally sure?

Too Many Bots
row.detailed_description: TOO MANY BOTS is a first-person action arcade built on a relentless hunt-or-be-hunted loop, a twisted test of survival inside retro-styled mazes. Before each run, choose a map and enter the experiment. Rules twist, roles flip, and the bots never stop. You’re prey one moment, hunter the next, caught in an endless cycle where adaptation is your only weapon. Every completed run increases the game difficulty, so mastering the mechanics is key to survival. Features Pure skill challenge with no metaprogression, only your ability to adapt and improve. Unlock new game modes, each with unique rules and objectives that rewrite how you play. Cycle endlessly between prey and hunter as the power balance shifts. Explore retro-PS1 maps, each with its own atmosphere and hidden pulse Survive endless swarms of bots, always there, always looming. Collect temporary power-ups to boost your survival just a little longer. Every run ramps up the difficulty, pushing your reflexes to the limit. In Too Many Bots , you're on your own. Every mode is a puzzle where you must find the winning strategy under pressure. Adapt. Survive. Repeat.
row.short_description: TOO MANY BOTS is a first-person action arcade. Dive into brutal, retro-PS1 mazes, alternate between prey and hunter, face endless bot swarms, collect temporary power-ups, and adapt to ever-changing rules. Every run ramps up difficulty, testing your reflexes and strategy.

row.name: Beer Machine
row.detailed_description: Your father needs a beer, and it's your job to get it.   You’re just a kid, but you have work to do. Search across your house, neighborhood, and mind to find what your father needs, and bring it back to him. Be quick though, it isn't safe for children to be alone. Watch out for yourself. No one else will do it for you. Beer Machine tells the story of a child and his abusive father. Jump into the child’s mind and see how it came to be this way, and do what you can to help your father. Beer Machine is a story-driven walking sim with mature and horror elements. You will be searching for objects and completing small activities as you play through the narrative.

row.name: TEMPUS: A Wizard Awakes
row.detailed_description: A Wizard alone in a shattered world Journey across Tempus, a world of floating islands flora and fauna. You are a lonely wizard, once a caretaker of the temporal flows, now retired and hoping for the world to return to what it once was. With no purpose left a call to action comes from a small rock critter, crying for help as it finds itself far from home and lost in the wilderness. Use your magic to guide the critter and it's family home while you traverse hostile terrain, solve puzzles, fight vegetative enemies and find secrets in this charming student-made action adventure game. And if you don't want to save the critters... There's always the alternative.. Magic In the world of Tempus, magic is not free. Every action has consequence and as such you must be careful when harnessing the energy of your surroundings to fuel spellcasting. Carelessness will limit your options and you may just find yourself in a pickle. On the flipside, move  without haste and the friends you make along the way might lend you a hand or crystal to aid your spell slinging adventure. A Reactive world With only a simple projectile TEMPUS aims to provide some engaging moments and fun interactions through handcrafted challenges, puzzles and environments. Take your time to explore a small world and journey through the clouds. Blast a companion, hug a 'friend', the world will carry on without you in the end. Secrets While the main story is short, we've made sure to include several achievements and secrets for curious players to find and hopefully enjoy, give it a whirl if you dare, take a leap of faith and don't trust a flower by it's petals. Thank you for playing!
row.short_description: Lead the critters home as a retired Wizard, a caretaker of the world in this charming student project that takes you across floating islands and magical puzzles. Harness the energy of nature to fuel helpful spells. But beware, nature might fight back.

row.name: Cardinal Fall
row.detailed_description: Brought to you by Metahusk, this game is an educational Unreal Enigne project that is intended to help others learn how to develop games. If you're curious, give it a try. The game is more bug-free than a lot of commercial releases. But if you're expecting a similar experience to what you get from a paid game, this game may not be for you.  Note: This is an early release.  Networking and co-op are implemented, but this release only includes the introductory level where there is no co-op gameplay outside of finding each other through coordination and having the correct items. If you are looking for a co-op game to play with friends, check back in the future. Until then, we recommend playing the game by yourself . About the game: Cardinal Fall is a nonprofit, community-developed, story-driven, 3d side-view, single to four player multiplayer, survival-horror, co-op videogame set within an original far-future dystopian sci-fi universe. Set in the year 2742, you play as a clone—known as an Echo—located in a research facility where catastrophic events are unfolding. In the game, players will explore a series of sprawling locations while planning a way to escape their eventual fate. Having multiple outcomes, Cardinal Fall will test the player and their friends as they navigate, learn, and survive the hostile environment they find themselves trapped within. Shepherded by Metahusk, a US based IRS 501(c)(3) nonprofit, Cardinal Fall is a community project that is being developed for free by volunteers. This is an entirely donation driven game. If you like this project, you can donate by purchasing our Donation DLC on Steam or by visiting our website at more information. The game is currently in production. This is an early release that features the introductory level. If you are a developer and would like to contribute, we would love to hear from you. This side-scroller version is an early prototype of a larger first-person edition we plan to produce in the future. In the first-person release of the title, the focus will be placed on the immersion, horror, and atmospheric elements of the game.
row.short_description: Cardinal Fall is a nonprofit, community-developed, story-driven, 3d side-view, survival-horror, single or co-op game set within an original far-future dystopian sci-fi universe where you play as a clone—known as an Echo, located in a research facility where catastrophic events are unfolding.

row.name: Fate of the Minotaur
row.detailed_description: In FATE OF THE MINOTAUR you embody the role of a human sacrifice from Athens who is sent into the labyrinth designed by the architect Daedalus. It was commissioned by King Minos of Crete to contain the ferocious Minotaur. Throughout this 10-20 minute experience players will enter the labyrinth below King Minos palace navigate through it with an interactive torch to unveil the story gather insights into the ancient Greek myth by encountering key characters and narrating murals solve user-friendly puzzles decide the fate of the Minotaur in a final confrontation Play by navigating through the scenery and interacting with your controllers. We carefully minimized motion sickness through vignettes and seamless level transitions. A guiding thread will help you if you get lost. Development background information In a unique approach, this content can be experienced in different immersive scale options, depending on the technical and physical limitations of the location presenting the experience. From a technical perspective, a novel engine-agnostic and flexible open-source virtual production framework was used to realize the multiplayer network aspect of the game. This is the singleplayer only version. The 8x8m free-roaming or controller-based setup for up to 4 players is currently only to be played on-site at conferences/trade fairs. Our stylized visual approach is inspired by ancient Greek murals and vases, allowing us to provide the experience with a small footprint in energy consumption and required equipment.
row.short_description: Within this narrative VR experience FATE OF THE MINOTAUR, players descend into the mythical labyrinth, learn about the Minotaur’s tragic story and confront him to escape.
row.notes: confrontation and optional fight with a monster (Minotaur)

row.name: Tichupro by Spectrum
row.detailed_description: Discover TichuPro, one of the most thrilling strategic card games in the world! Played by two teams of two players, each team competes to reach the required points, while bonus points are awarded to the team that gets rid of their cards first. Play the popular card game Tichu online! 🔥 Key Features: ✅ Online Multiplayer – Play with friends or challenge real players worldwide. ✅ Strategic Gameplay – Use smart tactics and teamwork to win. ✅ Special Cards – The four unique cards (Dragon, Phoenix, Dog, Mah Jong) add depth to your strategy. ✅ Fast & Dynamic Rounds – Enjoy quick-paced matches with an intuitive interface. ✅ Tournaments & Leaderboards – Compete in events and climb the rankings! ♠️ Join the TichuPro Community and play like a Pro! Are you ready to master Tichu? Download now and start playing! 📥 Play Tichu today and test your strategic skills! TichuPro by Spectrum is an independent online version of the classic Tichu game and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to the creators or owners of the Tichu trademark.
row.short_description: Enjoy Tichupro, inspired by the famous strategic card game! Play with real users from around the world!

row.name: Gnomes on the Roam
row.detailed_description: Gnomes on The Roam is set in a world where a race of interdimensional gnomes that feed off sunlight have come to our world seeking our sunlight whether we like it or not. Their world has become uninhabitable as the Gnomes have harnessed and taken all of the energy from their sun causing it to extinguish. In true gnome fashion they decided to use the remaining sun power they had to travel dimensions to ours, they may not have come in peace, but we will send them back in pieces. Gnomes on the Roam is an infinite horde survival game where you have to defend yourself against the gnome onslaught. Use Plants to help you along your quest and find a way to harness the power of the sun to send them back to where they came from. Key features: Infinite rounds - see how long you can survive against an endless swarm of gnomes that all want you dead. weapons - find an upgrade both a pistol and an assault rifle within the game to help arm yourself against the gnomes plants - Find and plant seeds around the map to create plants that will assist you in your mission  Easter egg - There is a secret way to win the game if you can harness the suns power, can you find it?
row.short_description: Fend off endless waves of increasingly difficult Gnome attackers that will stop at nothing to destroy humanity. Can you foil the Gnome plans and send them back to their dimension or will you shatter under the pressure?

row.short_description: Secretly playing your Generic-90s-Handheld-Video-Game-Console during a first date? Shame on you!

row.name: Exit Dream
row.detailed_description: Step into a series of surreal dreams where nothing behaves as expected. This short first-person horror game blends unsettling atmosphere with puzzle-like challenges, creating moments of confusion, tension, and discovery. Psychological Horror - Fear born in the mind. Dream Puzzles - Each dream presents a unique challenge with its own strange logic. Atmospheric & Surreal - Minimal UI, no dialogue, just raw immersion. Compact Experience - Designed to be finished in one sitting, but with difficulty that rewards persistence and experimentation. Explore, adapt, and escape the logic of dreams - if you can.
row.short_description: A free short first-person horror game of dream puzzles - unsettling, surreal, and hauntingly atmospheric.

row.name: Ship Battle
row.detailed_description: 本游戏是一款以英雄帆船为主角的动作射击游戏，玩家操控帆船在屏幕内自由移动，通过WSAD键控制方向，Shift键加速，鼠标瞄准左键射击，按Q自动开火，按V使用清屏道具。游戏中多种敌人分阶段出现，具有不同攻击和移动方式，击败敌人可获得分数和随机道具，提升帆船属性与技能。背景持续滚动营造动态感，UI实时显示生命、分数及道具信息。 本游戏只是用来体验上架流程的作品，质量低请见谅

row.name: Ephemeral Art: Shapeweaver
row.detailed_description: Ephemeral Art: Shapeweaver is a unique art sandbox game where you create interactive artwork with shapes. It's designed for anyone curious to explore and play — no artistic skill required. With simple controls and endless possibilities, this 2D world of color, shapes, and motion is your personal creative playground. Your creations are temporary, destined to fade, giving you the freedom to experiment without limits. Unleash the artist within by crafting a relaxing visual spectacle, or embrace chaos — flinging shapes across the canvas and combining special effects for spectacular results. The choice is yours; there's no wrong way to play. A Universe of Customization at Your Fingertips Endless Shape Variations: Choose from a wide variety of shapes, including circles, squares, triangles, stars, hearts, and many more. Customize your shapes with a vast color palette, or let the game cycle through colors for a dynamic visual experience. Adjust the size, style, and weight of your shapes. Make them bold, outlined, or even dotted for a unique look. Apply different fill patterns and textures to give your creations a distinct personality. Over 30 Animated Backgrounds: Set the mood over 30 unique animated backgrounds to choose. Each background reacts to your clicks when placing shapes onto the canvas, creating a truly immersive experience. From tranquil starry nights to vibrant, pulsating nebulae, there's a background for every mood and style. Unleash Your Inner Artist with Powerful Tools: Grab Shape Tool: Take direct control of your creations! A simple click selects a shape, while a long press and drag allows you to select multiple shapes. Once selected, edit your shapes, move them to the perfect spot, or even fling them across the screen and watch them bounce off the canvas and other shapes. Undo and Redo: Experiment without fear! Instantly reverse any action with the Undo and Redo buttons, giving you the freedom to explore every creative possibility. Gravity and Physics: Bend the laws of physics to your will! Apply gravitational forces to your shapes and watch them interact in fascinating ways. Make them fall, orbit a central point, or float weightlessly in your digital canvas. Breakable Shapes: Introduce an element of controlled chaos with breakable shapes. Watch as your creations shatter into pieces upon impact. Fuse and Unfuse: Combine multiple shapes to create complex and intricate designs. The fuse tool allows you to merge shapes into a single, cohesive object, while the unfuse tool lets you break them apart again. Custom Animations: Control the lifecycle of your shapes with customizable Entry and Dissolve effects. Have shapes bounce, spiral, or construct themselves onto the canvas, and watch them fade, pixelate, or shatter into pieces when they disappear. Special Effects: Elevate your art with a plethora of special effects. Make your shapes glow with a neon aura, imbue them with elemental powers like fire and ice, or make them transparent for a ghostly effect. Tailor Your Creative Space: Flexible Interface: Make the game truly yours by customizing the user interface. Choose from a variety of themes, adjust text sizes and styles, and even change the position of the control panel to best suit your workflow. Resizable & Pinnable Windows: Adjust the size of settings windows to fit your needs, and pin them to the screen for easy access while you continue to create and edit shapes on the canvas. Sculpt Your Atmosphere: Full Edit Mode: Take your creativity to the next level with Full Edit Mode. This feature pauses all shape animations and movements, allowing you to fine-tune your creations with precision and ease. Canvas Settings: Perfect your masterpiece with a range of canvas settings. Apply special filters for extra visual flair, add a blurred background to make your shapes pop, and adjust the scene lighting to create the perfect atmosphere. With HDR support, the vibrant colors of your shapes and the dynamic animated backgrounds will truly pop, creating a stunning visual experience. Personalize Your Experience: Favorite Your Settings: With so many customization options, you're bound to find your perfect setup. Favorite your most-used settings for quick and easy access in any creative session. Curate Your Soundtrack: Love a particular song? Add it to your favorites list to create a personalized playlist that perfectly matches your artistic vibe. Steam Cloud Support : Your personalized game settings are saved to the Steam Cloud, so you can pick up right where you left off on any computer. Capture Your Masterpiece: Photo Mode: Become the director of your own digital gallery. Freeze the action to compose the perfect shot, and independently manipulate background and shape movements to align effects precisely how you want them — even while time is paused. Professional Composition: Use the Zoom and Pan tools to frame your art perfectly. Choose from stylish Canvas Frames like Classic Gold, Neon Cyber, or Rustic Wood to give your screenshot a polished, professional look. Visual Filters: Transform the mood instantly with artistic Canvas Filters (Sepia, Vignette, etc.) or inject a dose of nostalgia with retro Screen Filters like CRT Scanlines, Dot Matrix, and Pixelate. High-Fidelity Exports: Photo Mode automatically shifts the game into Quality Mode, ensuring every screenshot is captured with maximum particle counts and the sharpest resolution possible. Game Modes for Every Playstyle Regular Mode: Challenge yourself against the clock in this classic mode. Create as much as you can before time runs out and your masterpiece begins to dissolve. Creative Mode: Unleash your creativity without any time pressure. This mode is a pure sandbox where you can experiment, explore, and create to your heart's content. More Than a Game Screensaver Mode: Activate Screensaver Mode to sit back, relax, and enjoy a seamless, ever-changing showcase of the game's animated backgrounds with multiple timer options. Or you can interact with the animated backgrounds by clicking on them for the full Screensaver Mode experience. Features Intuitive and easy-to-learn interface. Two distinct game modes to suit your playstyle. A chill collection of music to accompany your creative journey. A vast array of shapes, colors, and customization options. Over 30 unique animated backgrounds. Powerful tools including Grab Shape, Undo/Redo, gravity settings, breakable shapes, and shape fusion. A dedicated 'Full Edit Mode' for complete control over your creations. Photo Mode gives you a comprehensive suite for capturing high-quality screenshots with zoom, frames, and filters. Customizable Entry and Dissolve animations for your shapes. A wide variety of special shape effects to make your creations pop. Fully customizable user interface, including themes, text styles, window management, and layout options. Various canvas settings like special filters, blurred backgrounds, and scene lighting. HDR support for stunning, vibrant visuals. Steam Cloud support ensures your game settings are always saved and available. Favoriting system for quick access to your preferred settings and songs. Screensaver Mode allows you to enjoy the animated backgrounds with ease. Whether you want to create a breathtaking work of 2D art with shapes or just have fun playing with physics, colors, and animated backgrounds, Ephemeral Art: Shapeweaver is the perfect digital canvas for you. Get ready to shape your imagination!
row.short_description: Create, destroy, and discover. Ephemeral Art: Shapeweaver is a 2D digital playground where you can let your creativity run wild. Whether you're an aspiring artist or just looking for an art sandbox game, Shapeweaver offers a unique and engaging experience for everyone.

row.name: HERE - Immersive Music Theater
row.detailed_description: Created by Michel van der Aa Award-winning composer and director Michel van der Aa brings his passion for innovative narrative forms to the digital realm. HERE offers a unique blend of cinema and interactive performance. Users can shape the narrative, creating a personalized experience that explores the boundaries of reality and identity. This launch comes fresh off Michel van der Aa's win for Best Immersive Work at Cannes International Film Festival 2025 for his latest VR creation 'From Dust.' HERE makes cutting-edge music theater accessible to a diverse audience, including those who might not typically attend traditional venues. Using VR on your PC, this app offers a fresh way to engage with contemporary performance, bridging the gap between creator and audience in the comfort of your own space. Step into a virtual grand theater and be captivated by Julia Bullock's stunning aria from the acclaimed film opera 'Upload.' Immerse yourself in 'Eight,' the groundbreaking VR opera installation that has wowed audiences at festivals around the world, soon available in your living room. Explore 'The Book of Sand,' a VR adaptation of Jorge Luis Borges' novel that pushes the boundaries of digital storytelling. And that's just the beginning... HERE is produced by the doubleA foundation with support from DigitALL and Fonds Podiumkunsten.
row.short_description: Step into the future of immersive storytelling with HERE, a groundbreaking app for PCVR that brings music theatre into your home.

row.name: World War Chess
row.detailed_description: What is it? World War Chess is the first ever chess variant to feature a battle royale style of gameplay, with no limit to how many people can join! Content *Many different maps *Many different enemies controlled by unique AI *Battle against Bosses, and endless waves of enemies *Many other weird and interesting features like Conways Game of Life as an enemy Extra In case you are new to chess, there is a tutorial, and an easy-to-understand highlighting system to guide you as to where you can move.
row.short_description: This is 1000+ player chess! You are in a war, where every player matters and contributes! Your king is no longer the center of the world, but rather your Commander's king, a bossfight piece, is the new captain, and must be protected at all costs. Can you carry your comrades to victory?

row.name: atomica
row.detailed_description: Atomica is an immersive 3D exploration game that shrinks you down to the nanoscale and places you directly on the surfaces of proteins. Walk across vast molecular landscapes, climb over ridges, descend into grooves, and discover ligands as if they were hidden landmarks in a strange new world. Atomica blends science and adventure, turning the invisible world of biology into a place you can truly explore. Key Features Explore proteins in 3D – Wander across realistic molecular surfaces built from actual scientific data. Discover ligands – Find small molecules nestled in binding sites and learn their biological role. Immersive scale – Experience what it feels like to stand on the nanoscale architecture of life. Simple controls – Walk, look, and interact using only a game controller. Relaxing gameplay – No combat, timers, or stress; just exploration and discovery. Educational and fun – Perfect for players curious about science, students, or anyone who enjoys walking simulators with a twist. Why Play Atomica? If you’ve ever wondered what it would be like to step inside the microscopic world, Atomica lets you do just that. It’s a calm, surreal experience that blends gaming with science, offering a new perspective on the building blocks of life.
row.short_description: Atomica is a 3D exploration game where you walk across the surfaces of proteins, discover ligands, and experience the nanoscale world as an immersive landscape.

row.name: River Meditation
row.detailed_description: This app is a movement meditation that is both calming and energy building. It has an awareness game also. It can be done sitting, standing, or stepping. It is based on 9 simple moves, the main 5 of which are called Water, Wind, Fire, Ground/Earth, and Void. These names are like the 5 Chinese Elements and the 4 Western Elements, but they come from Miyamoto Musashi's Book of 5 Rings. The app has fun avatars and sound and graphics to keep the otherwise dry information interesting to use. It has a psychic/spiritual nature as well... some people sense a divine guidance or spiritual presence to the random postures that are selected. FOR PEOPLE USING FOR SERIOUS SELF DEVELOPMENT, We recommend using the Quick Calm section for 30 minutes a day during your training. If you can, do the postures alternating sitting and standing.
row.short_description: This app is a movement meditation that is both calming and energy building. It has an awareness game also. It can be done sitting, standing, or stepping. It is based on 9 simple moves, the main 5 of which are called Water, Wind, Fire, Ground/Earth, and Void.

row.name: 重返1941—剧版玉梦cp同人衍生
row.detailed_description: 《重返1941- 剧版玉梦CP同人衍生》 是一款 轻小说叙事与解谜结合 的 RPG Maker MZ 游戏。 故事发生在一个神秘而封闭的庄园中，阴影笼罩、真相扑朔迷离。你将扮演身处其中的角色，通过阅读剧情、探索环境和搜集线索，逐步拼凑出隐藏在背后的秘密。 🔎 游戏特色 沉浸式剧情体验 ：以轻小说方式呈现，结合对白与心理描写，营造紧张悬疑的氛围。 解谜与推理 ：通过线索搜集与逻辑思考，推动故事发展，揭开层层迷雾。 场景探索 ：深入裘庄等关键场景，体验压抑与神秘的空间感。 多线分支 ：不同选择可能引导至不同的剧情与结局。 如果你喜欢 悬疑氛围、故事驱动和解谜推理 ，这款游戏将为你带来一段独特的沉浸式体验。
row.short_description: 一款由 RPG Maker MZ 制作的轻小说解谜游戏。玩家将在裘庄等场景中搜集线索、推理真相，体验紧张而悬疑的剧情故事。

row.name: Star Man
row.detailed_description: Star Man About This Game A survival adventure where you build a raft and escape from a deserted island. Playtime Approx. 30 hours Features Gathering, crafting, sailing, and questing. A story equivalent to 60,000 words of a novel. English Mode Supported. Streaming and Let's Plays We wholeheartedly welcome them! You don’t need to include the game title in your video title or add the store page URL in the description. Feel free to stream or upload videos as you like. Note The game resolution is fixed at 1600x900. Please adjust your monitor’s resolution accordingly when playing.
row.short_description: A survival adventure where you build a raft and escape from a deserted island.

row.name: Heartopia
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Heartopia, a multiplayer life simulation game crafted for creativity, freedom, and peace. Build your dream home, explore a wide range of hobbies, and forge warm connections with friends in a town full of endless possibilities. [Game Features] ◆ Let's Connect! Create Unique Memories Chat with the charming residents of Heartopia Town, hang out with old friends, and meet new friends every time you log in! ◆ Let's Explore! Gardening, Fishing, Birding... Hobbies are yours to enjoy, not chores. In Heartopia, feel free to develop six major hobbies, including fishing, cooking, gardening, birdwatching, and more. ◆ Let's Build! Design Your Dream House Whether you dream of a cozy cottage or a magnificent mansion, Heartopia gives you the tools to turn your vision into a reality. You can also invite your friends over and build your dream home together. ◆ Let's Dress Up! 1000+ Daily Outfits Mix and match casual wear, elegant gowns, and whimsical costumes to create the perfect look for any occasion. While each of your furry friends may come with different colors and personalities, they can all bring you warmth and comfort. [Follow Us] X：@myheartopia TikTok：@heartopia_en Facebook：Heartopia Instagram：@myheartopia YouTube：@heartopia-official
row.short_description: Welcome to Heartopia, a multiplayer life simulation game crafted for creativity, freedom, and peace. Build your dream home, explore a wide range of hobbies, and forge warm connections with friends in a town full of endless possibilities.

row.name: NECROSYNTEX
row.detailed_description: NecroSyntex is a 3D co-op third-person shooter set in a near-future apocalyptic world. In an age where medical technology had reached unprecedented heights, a mysterious new drug spread across the globe—turning humans into horrifying mutant creatures. Now, the last survivors must rely on the same dangerous drugs, known as Doping , to gain the strength needed to fight back. As a special operative, you and up to three teammates are deployed into infested zones to complete missions, eliminate threats, and ultimately escape alive. Key Features 4-Player Online Co-op Play solo or team up with friends. Coordination and teamwork are the keys to survival. Doping System: Power at a Price 12 unique doping abilities across Offensive, Defensive, and Utility categories Choose 2 before each mission, regardless of category Can be used on yourself or allies — buffs and debuffs apply to both (strategic play or even trolling possible) Four Playable Characters Each with unique stats and a special Constitution passive that grants extra effects when using doping (without suffering additional debuffs). Mission-Based Gameplay Defend objectives, survive against waves, secure targets, and more — each mission offers new challenges beyond simple combat. High Risk, High Reward Fail a single mission, and it’s game over. If all players die, the operation ends. Friendly fire enabled — allies can be harmed, so think twice before pulling the trigger. Controls & Customization The game is played with keyboard (WASD for movement, R to reload, etc.) and mouse (aiming and shooting) . Key bindings are fully customizable through the in-game settings, allowing you to adapt the controls to your playstyle. Summary In a world ravaged by a mysterious drug that spawned countless mutants, you are a soldier enhanced by dangerous doping effects. Together with your squad, you must complete missions and fight your way to survival. But remember: every dose of power comes with a price.
row.short_description: A 4-player co-op shooter set in a world overrun by mutant creatures. Use powerful yet risky doping effects to fight alongside your team and complete missions.
row.notes: This game contains frequent violence and gore. Players will engage in combat against infected creatures (mutant) using a variety of firearms weapons. The game also features a horror setting with dark environments and sudden enemy appearances that may be frightening to some players.

row.name: Spray N' Pray
row.detailed_description: **A student team project designed to deliver a ~10 minute experience. Spray N' Pray is a fast-paced first-person boomer shooter where you play as Justinian, a priest chosen by God to purge the Earth of demons, hellspawn, and fallen angels. The cathedral is overrun, and only your faith, speed, and firepower can cleanse it. Armed with your signature dual revolvers, you’ll unleash a storm of righteous bullets while mastering smooth movement; dash, run, and melee-strikes that close the distance between you and your enemies. Unleash your ultimate power by merging your revolvers into one divine weapon, unleashing a blistering hail of bullets. And when demons close the gap, crush them with a brutal melee strike to break their ranks. With every kill, you climb closer to your holy reckoning.
row.short_description: Spray N' Pray is a fast-paced boomer shooter where you play as Justinian, a priest armed with dual revolvers. Dash, run, and jump through a demon-infested cathedral, vanquishing hellspawn and fallen angels to earn your righteous place in heaven.

row.name: ANDALAS : Realms of Eternal Lights Playtest
Sprite's City Scramble
row.detailed_description: Sprite's City Scramble is a 3D exploration-based puzzle platformer revolving around Sprite, an alien parasite who has come to our world to learn more about its inhabitants. As Sprite, you can take over different creatures that each have unique abilities which assist in exploring your environment, solving interactive puzzles and collecting “artifacts” which are random everyday items that, to Sprite, are invaluable sources of knowledge. Use all resources available to progress through various challenges so you can eventually return home with your newfound understanding of this strange and interesting planet. A game-jam game made by: Ewan Burkinshaw Henry Bunn Joshua Mahil Killian Khada Max Senior Ricco Vergara Robin Crews
row.short_description: A 3D puzzle-platformer where you play as Sprite, an alien parasite who can possess creatures with unique abilities. Explore, solve puzzles, and collect everyday artifacts to understand our world and find your way home.

row.name: Crazy Roads
row.detailed_description: Crazy Roads is a fast-paced, endless driving game set on stunning, procedurally generated forest roads. The goal is simple: drive fast, earn more points , creating a thrilling balance between speed and control as you navigate challenging curves to maximize your score. Points unlock a growing collection of unique cars, from hatchbacks to vintage sports cars, each with its own handling. Randomly generated tasks appear during gameplay, offering extra challenges and rewards. Completing them earns experience points to level up your car's mastery. In World Mode , the adventure expands as you travel the exact distance between any two countries. Once you've driven the real-world distance, the destination country is marked as 'traveled,' with the ultimate goal being to visit every country in the world. Combining instant arcade fun with deep progression, Crazy Roads makes every drive an exciting adventure with long-term goals. Endless gameplay with dynamically generated roads : A new, unique road is created with every playthrough. Speed-based scoring : The faster you drive, the more points you earn, creating a thrilling risk-vs-reward dynamic. Car collection : Unlock a growing garage of vehicles using the points you earn. Random tasks & challenges : Complete objectives during gameplay for bonus experience points. Car mastery system : Each car has its own progression level, allowing you to improve its performance and unlock new features. Customization rewards : Unlock new visual options and upgrades as you master each car. World Mode : A unique challenge where you travel the real-life distance between countries, with the goal of visiting every country in the world. Dynamic weather & seasonal changes: Experience rain, snow, storms, and shifting seasons that affect visibility, road conditions, and the atmosphere of each drive. Drive fast, complete challenges, master your favourite cars, and customize them to your style in this addictive arcade racing experience!
row.short_description: Crazy Roads is an endless driving game set on procedurally generated roads. Drive fast for points, which unlock unique cars. Complete challenges for car mastery and customization. A unique World Mode lets you travel the real-life distance between countries, with the goal of visiting them all.

row.name: TERPENIE
row.detailed_description: After a long day at work, you return home. Everything seems ordinary: preparing dinner, tidying up, and trying to put your life in order. But as night falls, the mundane becomes a fragile illusion. Someone is watching you. Someone is hunting you. In this game, you will explore the confines of your room while uncovering a terrifying truth. Balance the normality of everyday chores with a growing sense of dread, because the maniac may strike when you least expect it. Set against the backdrop of a post-Soviet setting, this game captures the haunting feeling of domestic horror and paranoia — the fear of being trapped with nowhere to run, even inside the walls of your own home. Can you keep your sanity and survive before the darkness takes over? Key Features Domestic Horror – a unique atmosphere inspired by life in the post-Soviet era. Routine Meets Fear – cook meals, clean your room, and explore while being watched. Unpredictable Threat – the maniac can appear at any moment, when you least expect it. Gritty Visual Style – a bleak, realistic environment of an old apartment. Psychological Tension – fear builds gradually, relying on atmosphere rather than cheap jump scares.
row.short_description: In the gloomy atmosphere of post-Soviet everyday life, routine tasks like cleaning, cooking, and exploring your own room hide something much darker. Survive and uncover the truth before the maniac comes for you.
row.notes: В игре присутствуют элементы психологического ужаса, слежки и тревожные сцены. Атмосфера мрачная и может вызвать дискомфорт у некоторых игроков.

row.name: Duelyst: Blitz
row.detailed_description: ⚡ Duelyst: Blitz is a lightning-fast reimagining of the beloved tactical card battler Duelyst. Engage in dynamic, turn-based duels where every move matters. With a streamlined 6-mana cap and a consistent 2-card draw each turn, Duelyst: Blitz delivers tight, decision-rich gameplay that rewards smart plays and bold tactics. Build your deck from a diverse roster of powerful units and spells, each brought to life with stunning hand-animated pixel art . Position your forces on the battlefield, outthink your opponent, and strike with perfect precision. Whether you’re a returning Duelyst veteran or a newcomer to tactical card games, Blitz offers the perfect mix of accessibility and depth. ⚡ First truly  cross-platform  version of Duelyst. 📱  iOS, Android and Steam releases 🍎 🤖 improved client performance 🏃‍♀️ touch (swipe) gestures support ☝️ 6 max mana, 60 seconds per turn ⏳ based on early Duelyst mechanics - 2 draw, no Bloodbound Spell 🧙 all profit from Orb purchases goes back into advertising budget (ads, influencer marketing, prized tournaments) 💸
row.short_description: Lightning-fast reimagining of the beloved tactical card battler Duelyst, designed for intense, strategic matches you can finish in just a few minutes. Engage in dynamic, turn-based duels where every move matters.

row.name: WAVEBEAM
row.detailed_description: In WAVEBEAM , 2-4 local players navigate the darkness while battling one another to be the last ship left. Fire your BEAM to destroy other ships and stay hidden while navigating the arena. Your PING not only reflects enemy BEAMs, but also reveals your surroundings and your location to everyone, so use it wisely! A Note from the Designer: The concept behind this game was developed by myself and a few others during the 2017 Global Game Jam. Eight years later, I wanted to experiment with modern AI coding tools to assess their capability and limitations. I spent about an hour distilling the game's concept and writing a comprehensive game design document that aligned with my own vision, then I provided an AI coding agent with the design doc. Although it missed the mark in a few areas initially, the agent started out with something surprisingly playable that roughly reflected the design. After about 10 hours of additional tweaks, additions, and iterations, I ended up something that I was happy to share with the public - all without writing a single line of code. The product of this experiment was well worth the time and money put into it, and while I could have developed this game entirely myself as a Software Engineer, I chose to do so with the use of AI and thus can't justify charging anyone for it. HOWEVER - if you want to invest in the ongoing development of this game, I'll gladly accept donations via an upcoming 'Dev Support DLC', or you can donate via Venmo (@RyanCollins86) or reach out to me directly via . I'll be sharing a roadmap in the Discord where you can also chat with other players, report bugs, and provide suggestions new features for the roadmap.

row.name: Shibuya Bullet
row.detailed_description: - How to Play This game cannot be played on its own. To play, open a live video (e.g. YouTube) on the left half of your monitor, and run this game on the right half. Align the frames carefully, then control Shibumaru using the WASD keys or your mouse. You can find the live video on the Steam forums. Where is everyone hanging out? - Story One day, a baby alien named Shibumaru crash-landed in the middle of Shibuya Scramble Crossing—one of the most famous intersections in the world. Shibumaru is terrified of humans. Your mission is to guide him to a safe place—away from humans. - Behavior Not much is known about Shibumaru’s biology. He loves mouse cursors, and for some reason, he’s not afraid of white or gray humans. Maybe they resemble the colors of his missing parents? Sometimes he trips over nothing (which results in a game over). But hey, he’s just a baby—please be gentle! - How to Play This game cannot be played on its own. To play, open a live video (e.g. YouTube) on the left half of your monitor, and run this game on the right half. Align the frames carefully, then control Shibumaru using the WASD keys or your mouse. - Game Mechanics Hit detection is based on color: everything except crosswalk white and road gray is considered a target. In other words, Shibumaru might just slip right through people dressed in white or gray—oops! Also, no AI is used for detection, so if you trip in an empty spot, it's not intentional (there’s no “falling” logic built in). - Development Challenges This game relies on color-based detection, which can behave very differently depending on your PC or display environment. Older machines—and surprisingly, even some newer laptops—can reproduce colors in ways that drastically affect detection accuracy. Fine-tuning the collision logic has been one of the hardest parts. On the desktop PC used for development, everything works smoothly. But on two different laptops I own, the character barely reacts to people—even when clearly colliding. Please note that gameplay may vary depending on your system. - Copyright This application is completely free. It does not store, redistribute, or monetize any external video content.

Special Deployment System : Unlimited deployment mechanism - as long as supplies last, continuously expand your fleet to create overwhelming advantages or surprise tactics. Strategic Depth Turn Phases : Acquire combat resources, activate tactical preparations, deploy units, place facilities, use support cards, command space fleet battles, post-battle adjustments and redeployment, end turn processing. Strategic Elements Resource Management : Make crucial choices between survival and expansion - every supply point matters. Unit Configuration : Multiple unit categories including Human, Mammalian, Arthropod, each with unique tactical characteristics. Trait Combinations : Legion and Fleet trait systems that create powerful synergies. Tactical Timing : Master optimal moments to play support and tactical cards, controlling the battlefield tempo. Unit Types : Basic units, large units, support facilities, and more - build diverse tactical systems. Game Features Complete Battle System : 2-player and 4-player modes with online, LAN support, and spectating. Deck Management : Intuitive card collection manager, powerful deck builder, search and filter functions, import/export capabilities. Interface & Experience : Modern UI design, full Chinese localization, sound effects and visual support. Join the galactic battlefield now and experience unprecedented strategic card gameplay! row.name: 手撕道祖，脚踩大乘（Tao Ancestor's Vanquisher）
row.detailed_description: Introduction In Tao Ancestor's Vanquisher  you play as Xuan Che, the Eternal Dao Ancestor betrayed in his past life and reborn into the body of a despised 'good-for-nothing' youth. Now the young master of the Profound Heaven Sect who cannot even gather spiritual energy, he endures public scorn and internal family strife. Faced with a disappointed fiancée, mocking peers, and hidden enemies from his past, will you live in obscurity or reclaim your power to settle old scores? In this tale of power, betrayal, and redemption, the epic secret of the 'Heart-Devouring Curse' begins to unfold.   Features Subverts Tropes:  Reborn as a max-level expert. Focus on personal growth, relationships, and strategic plots over leveling up. Complex Characters:  Morally grey cast with deep motives, especially the nuanced antagonist Zi Xuan. Full Chinese VO:  High-quality voice acting enhances immersion. Your Choices Matter:  Decisions lead to vastly different endings. Authentic Soundtrack:  Traditional Chinese melodies and intense battle music. Objectives Primary Goal:  Uncover the truth of your past betrayal, confront your clan's crisis and the demon invasion, and face the ultimate threat—the Heart-Devouring Demon Sovereign, a calamity born from your own actions. Conceal Your Power:  Master the balance between your 'useless' facade and necessary displays of strength to avoid premature attention. Clan Politics:  Navigate schemes from envious siblings, discrimination from outer-clan disciples, and infiltration by external forces. Complex Relationships:  Manage nuanced ties with your fiancée, a loyal maidservant, and others; your choices will shape their destinies. Test of Dao Heart:  Face powerful enemies and moral crossroads. Your principles—whether you uphold righteousness or embrace ruthlessness—will determine your final ascension. Character Xuan Che — Play as the young master of Xuantian Sect, secretly reborn as a Grand Dao Ancestor. Though appearing powerless, he wields strength far beyond the Nascent Soul realm and commands the primal forces of heaven and earth. Uncover the truth of his rebirth and reshape the destiny of his sect. Zixuan - Xuan Che's loyal maid. Once an ordinary mortal, she rapidly ascends to the power of the Nascent Soul realm. Initially kind and devoted, she grows arrogant and cold with her newfound strength, harboring deep contempt for her humble past. Han Xuesheng — Xuan Che's fiancée. Values status and strength above all, her feelings toward him torn between lingering expectations and profound disappointment. Mo Cangqiong — Senior disciple of the Xuantian Sect. An orphan who ultimately betrayed his clan, his treachery deepening the sect’s crisis. Mysterious Figure: Xuan Sheng — Founder of the Xuantian Sect, who should have perished in a heavenly tribulation but survived through demonic energy. Now a shadowy puppeteer, he guides Zixuan to embrace both demonic power and heavenly trials.

It stays close, quietly judging your life choices while you work and play. Items & Customization As you use your PC, you earn points by typing and clicking. Common (85%), Uncommon (10%), Rare (4%), Epic (0.95%), Legendary (0.05%) Crafting & Upgrading Have duplicate items or styles you do not use?  Combine items of the same rarity to craft one from the next tier. You can also feed items to your worm to add more body segments, so it slowly grows longer over time. Comfort Settings You can scale the worm to be tiny or big , just how you like it. Resize the pocket, and adjust many settings  to make your companion feel cozy on your desktop. Made for Focus & Breaks Use the Pomodoro timer to work in gentle focus blocks with clear breaks. Turn on the Anti-Shrimp stretch reminder so the worm can remind you to sit up straight, stand up, and stretch. It is a small, friendly nudge to take better care of yourself while you are at your PC.
row.short_description: A tiny desktop worm pet that moves when you type, click, or play. Dress it up with hats and skins, park it in a pocket where its gaze follows your mouse, and let its Anti-Shrimp reminders nudge you to sit up and stretch.

row.detailed_description: 《神魔武圣》——传奇新巅峰，等你来战！🎮 开发团队耗时良久，精心雕琢，倾尽全力打造出这款全新传奇力作《神魔武圣》🌟！它以震撼之姿打破传统战法道界限，为玩家开启一场前所未有的热血传奇之旅！ 💥创新职业，一人成军 全新「神器使者」单职业闪亮登场，集近战爆发、远程范围、辅助增益于一身，真正做到全能无短板！技能树自由搭配，玩法丰富多样，左手挥刀斩烈火，右手唤雷降天罚，一人即是一支军队，在战场上所向披靡，让敌人闻风丧胆！😎 👫自由外观，个性彰显 角色无性别限制，自由选择男性/女性外观！无论你是钟情霸气猛男的硬朗风范，还是偏爱飒爽女战神的飒气英姿，这里都能满足你的需求。更有炫酷时装、翅膀、神器光效随心搭配，颜值与战力并存，让你打造独一无二的巅峰形象，成为游戏世界中最耀眼的存在！💃🕺 🎁丰厚福利，轻松起航 新人上线即可领取大量奖励，还有海量剧情任务等你探索，丰厚资源助力你快速成长，轻松开启传奇征程！🎉同时，游戏设有丰富多样的会员礼包，满足不同玩家的需求： 青铜会员 ：五彩之灵 10，阴烛灯，绑定元宝 50000 白银会员 ：五彩之灵 20，鉴定石 10，绑定元宝*100000 黄金会员 ：修为丹，书页 100，绑定元宝 200000 铂金会员 ：魂印 50，10倍隐藏地图卷，绑定元宝 300000 钻石会员 ：高级修为丹，生肖图腾 50，绑定元宝 500000 星耀会员 ：灵魂宝石 50，战功令 50，绑定元宝*1000000 王者会员 ：残阵碎片 100，功勋 50w，绑定元宝*2000000 📋实用攻略，助力霸业 💎打金攻略 起步资金与低投入策略 ：开服第一时间进游戏快速升级，建议充完18元的首充礼包，自动拾取大量掉落奖励，拿到铂金会员卡秒升铂金会员，大幅度提升人物属性，快速抢占终极BOSS，开启财富之路！💰 升级与任务 ：游戏初期，跟随主线任务走是最有效的升级方式。完成主线任务后，使用经验丹快速提升角色等级，70级后可直接进入练功房快速提升至100级。达到100级后，继续做主线任务和每日挑战任务、悬赏任务等，迅速提升角色实力，获取更多资源。📈 地图选择 ：不同地图有不同BOSS，掉落资源和装备各异，合理选择地图至关重要。 等级转生地图 ：所有类型的野外BOSS和终极BOSS均有几率产出本服顶级装备和材料。 封号地图 ：达到指定封号等级可进入，更容易获得战功令、转生装备。 灵魂地图 ：佩戴指定灵魂刻印可进入，更容易获得魂印、转生装备。 神器地图 ：佩戴指定八大神器可进入，更容易获得灵魂宝石、成品神器。 隐藏地图 ：可越级打高级终极BOSS，高爆感受，但伴随强力竞争和PK，建议达到一定实力再去，所有BOSS均有几率掉落隐藏地图。🗺️ 👹BOSS挑战攻略 BOSS选择策略 ：不同BOSS掉落不同资源和装备，根据自己的角色战力和装备水平选择适合的BOSS进行挑战，避免资源浪费。🎯 适合平民玩家的BOSS ：零氪玩家可选择等级和转生地图中的BOSS，掉落物丰富且挑战难度适中；小氪和中氪玩家可挑战“会员之家”地图中的BOSS，掉落装备和资源更加珍贵。💪 高充值玩家的挑战 ：氪金玩家建议挑战更高等级的BOSS，如『十方』及以上的BOSS，掉落装备更加稀有，奖励极为丰厚。💎 🚀快速提升战力 副本与玩法 ：进入剧情地图，如“蛮荒禁地”，合成高阶配饰的同时获得高品质装备和属性加成，显著提高角色战斗力。副本奖励包括攻击力、防御力、吸血效果等，都是提升战力的关键。💯 系统功能 ：法阵系统、官位系统、封号系统、鉴定系统等功能可迅速增加人物的攻击、血量、切割等核心属性，全方位飙升，极大增强角色综合实力，助你傲视群雄，成就一代霸主！👑 💡BOSS挑战要点 套装利用 ： 疾速套装 ：大幅度增强人物攻击速度，帮助玩家快速击杀BOSS。 石化套装 ：大幅度减轻BOSS的反击威胁，提高挑战成功几率，合理利用石化效果，面对强敌时能有效减少战斗中的风险和损失。 诅咒套装 ：攻击怪物时附加施毒的buff效果，降低目标怪物防御和回复效果，提高杀怪效率。🛡️ 适当挑战等级 ：挑战BOSS时，确保自己的战力与BOSS等级匹配，避免挑战过高等级的BOSS导致失败，浪费资源。📊 💰氪金推荐 潜能激活礼包 ：对于高充值玩家来说，时装和武器礼包是最具性价比的氪金选择。礼包中的永久时装和武器不仅提升角色外观，更提供攻速加成、敌人麻痹、施加诅咒等多重战斗效果，大幅提升战斗力，迅速在游戏中获得优势。👗🔫 强化与增值装备 ：高氪金玩家投资强化装备和增值道具也是提升战力的有效方式。不断强化武器、盔甲等装备，提升角色综合属性，在挑战高难度BOSS时增加更多生存机会。💪 《神魔武圣》已热血开启，快来加入这场传奇盛宴，书写属于你的辉煌篇章！🎉
row.short_description: 《神魔武圣》全新「神器使者」单职业闪亮登场，集近战爆发、远程范围、辅助增益于一身，真正做到全能无短板！技能树自由搭配，玩法丰富多样，左手挥刀斩烈火，右手唤雷降天罚，一人即是一支军队，在战场上所向披靡，让敌人闻风丧胆！😎

row.name: Ocean Fishooter
row.detailed_description: Dive into the Thrilling New World of <Ocean Fishooter> After years of dedication and passion, we're thrilled to unveil our most magnificent creation yet—a fishing adventure like no other! [Why You'll Love Ocean Fishooter] Shoot, Score, and Conquer! Arm your cannon, take aim, and fire at a dazzling variety of sea creatures. Reel in big wins with every shot and dominate the deep! 【Enhanced Fishing Gameplay】 The era of Strategic Fishing is here! Your choice of firepower determines your victory! Phonix Power (Single Target Annihilation): Target locked! Summon a Fire Phoenix with a 5x Reinforced Bullet to focus fire directly on the Boss's weak point, dramatically reducing kill time! Dragon Power (Area Sweep): Area bombardment! A 7x Reinforced Bullet triggers chain lightning, its widespread attack leaving no small fish hidden, easily achieving a clean sweep! 【Mighty Bosses】 Fortune King: 【Treasure Bag Draw!】 Chance to pull a multiplying 'Golden Dragon' or a prize-winning 'Koi'! Experience the thrill of opening a lucky chest! Coin Clown: 【Hat Trick】 The surprises never stop! The unpredictable jester's magic randomly conjures a multiplying 'Tiger King' or a prize-winning 'Rabbit'! Raging Dragon: 【Go All Out!】 Capture the Dragon and don't let it break free from its chains! Test your sustained firepower and precision! Vampire King: 【Multiplier Accumulation】 Continuous shooting builds up the prize pool! row.short_description: Try the best fish-shooting game and experience the most thrilling shooting action and the most immersive adventure! Start your hunting journey now — challenge sea creatures, zombie hordes, fantasy monsters, and ancient dinosaurs to hone your shooting skills!

row.name: Slug Survival
row.detailed_description: Survive. Adapt. Destroy. Welcome to Slug Survival , a fast, chaotic top-down arena shooter where every second counts. Face off against bio-engineered slugs that learn, adapt, and strike harder with every wave. Move fast and blast through relentless slug swarms that grow faster, meaner, and more unpredictable each round. Keep moving, keep firing or get overrun. Collect power-ups to boost your firepower and unlock devastating multi-shot upgrades. Stack your boosts to unleash up to five shots at once , melting everything in your path.  Every pickup is a step toward survival or total annihilation. Face powerful, tougher, smarter, and far more dangerous  boss slugs  that get even tougher at key milestones. Defeat them to earn massive bonuses , unlock game-changing upgrades , and push your survival to the limit. Compete for the top spot and show off your survival skills. Earn higher scores, survive longer, and cement your name among the best Slug Slayers.
row.short_description: Survive endless waves of evolving slugs in a fast-paced top-down shooter. Adapt, Upgrade your weapon or not and blast your way through slug swarms that are more chaotic with every wave. One arena, Infinite chaos.

row.name: Zombie Hunter
row.detailed_description: About The Game This game is developed by a middle school student in less than one month. It has no storyline and might be quite boring—it might not even qualify as a proper game. : In the game, players take on the role of a hunter who hunts zombies : In this game, there is no one truly reliable; the only thing you can fully trust is the gun in your hand : Zombies will rush at you from all directions—will you flee or take the initiative to attack : The game offers a wide array of weapons for players to choose from : You will hunt by lakesides and in dungeons : The game provides guidance, so you will always know what to do next : The soundtrack will deliver an immersive experience for players Development Costs : Excluding time and labor costs, it was approximately $700. Honest Thoughts : The game will undoubtedly have many bugs and shortcomings. : The game was built entirely from scratch, without using any templates. : Finally, thank you very much for playing. I will accept all criticism and suggestions, and I also hope you’ll be gentle with the harsh comments (QAQ). Wishing you a pleasant experience!
row.short_description: In an apocalyptic world full of dangers, the only thing you can trust is the weapon in your hand. Survival must be earned by yourself.
row.notes: This game may contain content that is not suitable for all ages or may not be appropriate for viewing during work: frequent violence or gore, and general adult content.

row.name: Uh Oh!
row.detailed_description: ' Uh Oh!' is a short horror experience about exploring an abandoned experimentation facility to confront a hidden evil. In Uh Oh!   you'll evade gruesome monsters and discover the twisted truth behind their origins. Play through intertwined trials while evading the abhorrent giants roaming the facility.  Features Immersive found footage format, experience the game through a retro VHS camcorder Fend off from disturbingly familiar foes Spatialized, handcrafted audio A short experience intended to last around an hour
row.short_description: Play through three VHS tapes, uncovering the mystery of a decrepit facility, eluding tormented beasts, and discovering the truth of the chosen one.
row.reviews: “This game had me shivering my timbers!” 10/10 – Pirates

row.name: Full Steam
row.detailed_description: In Full Steam, take control of Scrapper and fight for your freedom in this 2D, side-on, endless runner - with survivor like elements. Bust free from the iron grip of the tyrannous overlord in a ruthless steampunk world. Survive the pandemonium and battle through hordes of volatile enemies, collecting experience to upgrade your rig from tin shell, to battle hardened. Keep up the pace, or the Steam King will catch you and send you to the scrap heap. How Long can you run for?
row.short_description: Take control of Scrapper and fight for your freedom in this 2D, side-on, endless runner. Survive the pandemonium and battle through hordes of volatile enemies, collecting experience to upgrade your rig from tin shell, to battle hardened.

You can experience the game's full storyline for free—this is the redemption journey of the protagonist, 'Eggy' If you want to see the story brought to life with live actors, search for Ballshit on STEAM to purchase and experience it! About the Game “Ah~ How did I turn into a girl!” “Maybe if I sleep it off, I’ll wake up normal again~” Jia Xu, a shut-in college streamer nicknamed “DanDan,” is mysteriously transformed into a cute girl overnight in the boys’ dorm—and his ridiculous new life begins! Armed with nothing but hormones and confusion, you’ll face your stunned roommates, your lifelong bros, their suddenly awkward girlfriends, and other unlucky classmates who’ve shared the same fate. row.short_description: Overnight, otaku “DanDan” wakes up in the college dorm… as a drop-dead gorgeous girl! His absurd new life begins—only to discover he’s not the only one. The once-icy campus queen Wu Yangyang, formerly a burly jock, and a chubby shut-in whose soul was always a pretty girl, are in the same boat.
