row.name: Pac-Snec
row.detailed_description: A Clash of Arcade Classics  Pac-Snec is the ultimate high-score hunting challenge of two beloved arcade genres into a single, intensely replayable experience. Grab that nostalgia and hold it close as you deep dive into a retro-inspired world where every move counts and the maze is your hunting ground. Core Gameplay & Mechanics  You control the Snec , a snake like entity tasked with navigating a procedurally generated Labyrinth . Your one true goal is consumption and dominance: Consume & Grow: Weave through the maze and devour scattered Orbs . Each orb increases your score and, crucially, your length. The Deeper Challenge: The longer your Snec grows, the more challenging the Labyrinth becomes. Collision with your own increasingly lengthy tail results in a game over. Goal: Survive, grow, and secure your position at the top of the Global Leaderboards (WIP) for ultimate bragging rights. Key Features & Content The Labyrinth is not empty. Lurking within are Spectres , agile creatures that patrol the maze. Avoid the Spectres: These creatures will chase and trap you. Mastering the map layout and predicting their movement is key to survival. Character Progression (WIP): Unlock new Snec bodies, unique visual trail effects, and spectral Spectre Skins   as you achieve high scores and complete in-game milestones. A feature-rich, dedicated arcade experience, designed for both quick sessions and deep mastery: Infinite Replayability: Navigate procedurally generated maps. No two Labyrinths are ever the same, ensuring a fresh challenge on every run. Multiple Game Modes: Test your skills in different ways: Classic Mode: The pure, unforgiving arcade experience. Dead End Mode:  Plan ahead, dead ends are unforgiving and portaling into a Spectre is less than ideal. Who You Gonna Call?: Play with NO Spectres! Easily customise your game to remove the threats and avoid your tail at any means necessary.
row.short_description: Have a nostalgic trip back in time to experience a fresh take on some classics. Eat orbs and extend your Snec to become the longest and coolest in the world!

row.name: Bip and Bop
row.detailed_description: 'Not that one, you have to do the other thing first!' Remember those games you used to play on the couch with a friend, laughing and shouting side-by-side? Here comes a new challenge that will put your friendship (and your patience) to the ultimate test. This is a puzzle platformer that can only be cleared when two people truly work together. One player flips a switch while the other dashes through the door. One acts as a stepping stone so the other can reach new heights. You'll literally have to work as one to beat these challenges! Strictly for Two!: Every level is meticulously designed for 2-player co-op. Going solo is not an option! (It's also lonely.) It's Okay to Fail!: Failure is just part of the fun! Instead of blaming your friend, just laugh it off and find a new approach. You're in this together! No Game Over!: The only 'Game Over' is when one of you decides to 'give up' first! Grab your favorite co-op partner and dive into this hilarious adventure today!
row.short_description: Help, step on, or sabotage your friend! In this 2-player only puzzle platformer, perfect chemistry is the only way through. Think your friendship can handle it?

row.name: ESC/APE
row.detailed_description: **A student team project designed to deliver a ~10 minute experience. ESC/APE throws you into the role of Abe, a genetically enhanced ape bred for combat and locked away in a sterile testing facility. After a lifetime of experiments, you’re finally given a chance to prove your worth, and the chance to break free! Master momentum and raw power in fast-paced, physics-driven combat. Slide under hazards, ground pound enemies into the floor, and hurl objects; or your foes themselves, into walls with bone-crushing force. Every movement is a weapon, and every trial pushes your abilities to the limit. Will you be just another specimen in the lab’s endless experiments, or the first to shatter its walls and escape?
row.short_description: ESC/APE is a first-person, physics-based combat game starring Abe, a genetically enhanced ape. Slide, ground pound, and throw your way through brutal trials to prove you’re the apex specimen and finally break free from the lab that caged you.

row.name: Project Monster
row.detailed_description: Project Monster is a tower defense game with Roguelite elements. You must become the commander of an army of monsters and summon monsters and defeat them to face the incoming enemies. Evolve monsters with loot earned by defeating enemies and gain items to strengthen them. Defeat the incoming enemies to the end to clear the stage. This game was developed by a team of four university students from Sungkyul University in Korea. While it still has many shortcomings, we welcome your feedback as we continue improving the game.
row.short_description: Project Monster is a tower defense game with Roguelite elements. Summon monsters and defeat them to fight off incoming enemies. Evolve monsters with loot and gain items to strengthen them.

row.name: Darkzan Adventure
row.detailed_description: Darkzan Adventure is a Medieval Arcade RPG full of humor, fast-paced action, and unusual characters. Explore mysterious lands, face the cult of Darkzan, and uncover bizarre events while playing solo, in co-op, or even in idle mode. 🎮 Game Modes Solo Campaign — You and 3 allies controlled by AI. Online Co-op — Form teams and combine skills with your friends. Idle Adventure — Let your heroes fight on their own and come back to collect rewards. 🏆 Why play? Dozens of unique characters with different abilities. Random events: enemy hordes, friendly travelers, wandering merchants. Frequent updates with more content and seasonal events. Rankings, achievements, and character customization.
row.short_description: Darkzan Adventure is a Medieval Arcade RPG full of humor, fast-paced action, and unusual characters. Explore mysterious lands, face the cult of Darkzan, and uncover bizarre events while playing solo, in co-op, or even in idle mode.

row.name: Island of Lost Things
row.detailed_description: Island of Lost Things is a cozy exploration game. Play as Eric, a spirit medium, who is navigating the space between life and death. Help trapped souls on the island by recovering lost items from their past, reconnecting them with their lives, and guiding them to make the ultimate decision: return to life or pass on to whatever comes next. Features: Explore three unique environments on the island., Interact with your resident pocket poltergeist, Geisty., Get to know the stories of three lost spirits., Dig, fish, and catch collectables tied to memories., Guide the spirits back to the land of the living… or not! Caution This game explores the following themes: drowning, death, and loss.
row.short_description: Play as Eric, a spirit medium, who is navigating the space between life and death. Help trapped souls by recovering items from their past, reconnecting them with their lives, and guiding them to make the ultimate decision: return to life or pass on to whatever comes next.

row.name: Kartfinity
row.detailed_description: Kartfinity is a casual racing game that never ends! You can zoom through community-created racetracks or build and publish your own. Infinite Driving: Drive around a never-ending racetrack with Infinite Mode, featuring tons of unique community-created levels. Level Creator: Create your own levels to be featured in Infinite Mode.
row.short_description: Kartfinity is a casual racing game that never ends! You can zoom through community-created racetracks or build and publish your own. Drive around a never-ending racetrack with Infinite Mode, featuring tons of unique community-created levels. Create your own levels to be featured in Infinite Mode.

row.name: GumPop!
row.detailed_description: GumPop! is a 3D Puzzle Platformer inspired by Portal and Bubble Bobble where you have to solve challenging Puzzles by using various types of Bubbles and Bubble abilities. You are the exterminator Wilhelmina (Billie) “Bubble” Tuck who is tasked to clear out one of the biggest and most famous sweet factory's in the world from mutated, oversized and dangerous sweets who overran the factory. The original version was created by the student project team Anonymous Animals at Mediadesign University (mdh) in Berlin. Anonymous Animals: Game Design: Antonia 'Anton' Dittmer, Leonhard Stettnisch, Samuel 'Sammy' Gower Art: Emily Schütze, Gina-Marie Bognar, Lucas Wuerth, Zhenyu Wang Programming: Conor Huismann, Isabelle Diehl Producing: Samuel 'Sammy' Gower Project Lecturers: Sylvius Lack, Heiko Ihde, Henning Janssen, Dustin Paasch
row.short_description: GumPop! is a 3D Puzzle Platformer. Solve Puzzles to find a way to the next room and clear out the sweet factory from mutated sweets with your Bubble Gum Gun.

row.name: Genesis
row.detailed_description: Enter an abandoned village where silence hides something far worse than decay. Genesis is a first-person survival horror experience where every shadow threatens to reveal the monster stalking you. You are not alone. The creature hunts relentlessly, forcing you to scavenge what little remains: revolver rounds, bandages, and scattered notes that hold the key to your escape. Each discovery brings you closer to freedom — or face-to-face with what lurks in the dark. Features First-person survival horror set in a desolate, abandoned village A terrifying monster that hunts and chases you without mercy Collect scattered notes to unravel the path to escape Manage scarce resources: revolver, bandages, and precious ammo Tense atmosphere with constant dread and no safe place to hide Will you escape the village, or will the monster make Genesis your final chapter?
row.short_description: A first-person survival horror set in an abandoned village. Scavenge notes, ammo, and supplies while being relentlessly hunted by a terrifying monster.
row.notes: Creepy looking monster and bloody body bags can be seen.

row.name: Chronigma
row.detailed_description: Who is this made for: Gamers who love hard-core time manipulation puzzles.  Story:  They called it the Time War. A conflict where humanity's greatest achievement, time travel, became its tombstone. Your father (Kronos) has dedicated his life to one purpose: your (Cygnus) training. This puzzle adventure is a series of his lessons (puzzles), and each one a challenging test of your ability to manipulate time.  Game: This is a single-player, story-rich, time-bending puzzle game. You use time travel to be in two places at once to solve increasingly complex puzzles. With the Chronigma device, you are never truly alone. The Chronigma device records your actions, allowing you to travel back in time, and team up with your 'Past Self' to solve puzzles impossible for a single person. Key Features Completely free game. Time Manipulation Puzzle Game: This is a challenging puzzle game and is meant for those that enjoy time manipulation puzzles. Team Up With Yourself: Record your actions and collaborate with your own 'Past Self' to overcome obstacles. A Journey Through Time: Explore 50+ handcrafted levels, from simple logic problems to multi-layered temporal challenges. Providing 4-6 hours of mind-bending puzzle gameplay. Play the Game Your Way: Stuck on a tricky paradox? Get a nudge in the right direction with in-game hints, or skip a level to come back to it later. You can also unlock all levels to explore the story at your own pace. And if for some reason you are not interested in the story, you can disable the dialogue in settings.  A Story of Hope at the End of Time: Uncover the secrets of the Time War and the heavy burden shared between a father and son, training to save a world they've never known. Bonus Challenge: For the truly dedicated, seek out and conquer difficult levels that will test your mastery of time to its absolute limit.
row.short_description: Master time in this story-rich time-bending puzzle game. You travel back in time to be in two places at once, to solve puzzles impossible to complete alone. Your success hinges on your ability to collaborate with yourself. Can you learn to manipulate time to save humanity?

row.name: Tai Chi Fusion
row.detailed_description: This app helps people do a simplified form of Tai Chi led by the computer. It requires no training or previous experience; you just follow along. There are 9 postures, which can be done sitting (just using the arms) or standing. If you are standing, you can make it more like real tai chi by doing the stepping correctly, which is explained by a video. This app is called Tai Chi Fusion because, in addition to the tai chi like movements, there are energies of Water, Wind, Fire, and Ground, which are stress responses and come from Miyamoto Musahsi's famous Book of Five Rings on Japanese Swordsmanship. There is also a 4 minute qigong routine and a game. Enjoy!
row.short_description: This app helps people do a simplified form of Tai Chi led by the computer. It requires no training or previous experience; you just follow along. There are 9 postures, which can be done sitting (just using the arms) or standing. If you are standing, you can take steps.

row.name: Frontier Outpost
row.detailed_description: Playtime Approximately 1.5 to 3 hours Gameplay You step into an abandoned military base. There, you will face unspeakable horrors… and your only goal is to survive and escape. Background The story begins when a curious child enters a restricted military zone. Inside, they experience terrifying events that defy explanation. Developer’s Note Frontier Outpost is the very first horror game created by a solo developer who learned Unreal Engine through self-study. The game may have many shortcomings, but this project represents my passion for learning and my determination to grow. I want to continue making horror games and improve step by step. If you share the same dream, feel free to reach out — I’m looking for people to join me on this journey. Distribution & Streaming Guidelines When streaming or uploading gameplay videos, please include the game’s title or a Steam link in the stream title or video description. This small gesture means a lot to a solo developer. The developer is not responsible for any damages or losses caused by the distribution of videos of this game.
row.short_description: Escape from a strange base
row.notes: This game contains scenes of fear, blood, and psychological horror. Some scenes may be disturbing to sensitive players. There is no sexual content, drug use, or self-harm depicted.

row.name: Journey to Slimetopia
row.detailed_description: Will you be the hero for this lone world? Set out on a journey through a minimalistic low poly world, once so peaceful, that fell into turmoil after the slimes have gone mad. Discover different environments, their inhabitants and secrets, climb the highest mushrooms of the mysterious swamp and fight your way into the depths of the crystal mines. Intense battles Use your wand to tackle hordes of slimes and feel the rhythm of battle as the portal opens and waves upon waves of slimes will charge your way. Use your sword to deal with groups of slimes, but wield it with caution, for it strikes slow. Keep track of all enemies around you and keep watch for those that trick your senses. Never rest, never hesitate, for the next wave is coming. A world full of secrets Many secrets await, big and small, for the eyes of a watchful hero. Discover all that this realm has to offer and listen to the retro soundtrack of worlds long past. Stare into the dancing flames and watch the sparks rise to the night sky as the mysteries of Slimetopia unfold.
row.short_description: Venture into an unknown world in this first-person arena shooter. Tread on paths none have walked before and search for secrets to upgrade your weapons. Wield a sword and wand to face hordes of slimes gone mad. Meet curious characters and become the hero which Slimetopia awaits.

row.name: Let's Save Mice
row.detailed_description: Custo mice ! Create and personalize your mouse to your own liking. Change color, pattern or even the size of the ears, cheeks and teeth. Experience the story! Experience the island’s story through interactive cutscenes, where you and your friends vote to decide what happens next. Fight! The rude and rowdy mice of this island have captured your friends! Whip up some trusty weapons and give them a good bonk before they get to you first! Explore! As a tiny mouse, you can climb, squeeze, and scamper through every nook and cranny of the island. Hidden secrets are everywhere—so get exploring! From towering trees to winding roots and mossy caves, every path leads to a new discovery just waiting to be found. Free your friends! The island you and your friends explore is filled with fellow mice waiting to be rescued. Each one is locked away, and only the right key can set them free! Search every corner of the island or take on quests from its quirky inhabitants to discover the keys and bring your companions back to safety. Features: Explore and solve puzzles with up to 3 friends Over 25 rescuable mice for now! Crafting and looting Quirky inhabitants with quests to complete Character customization Online co-op Gophy the Gopher!
row.short_description: Join up to three friends in this mouse-sized adventure! Explore, gather resources, solve puzzles, and battle enemies as you try to bring your kidnapped brothers and sisters home.

row.name: Sunday School
row.detailed_description: Sunday School is a short psychological horror inspired by surreal titles like The Exit 8 an P.T.  Step into a distorted world born from children’s drawings.  In 30–60+ minutes of tense, immersive gameplay, you’ll descend through haunting visions that blur the line between innocence and nightmare. GAME OVERVIEW You are trapped in a child’s mind, where trauma takes the form of a looping Sunday School corridor, you must distinguish normal rooms from those tainted by disturbing anomalies. Only by choosing correctly you can break the loop. Choose wrong exit from the room, and the cycle begins again. Pay close attention to the signs guiding your way, and descend through all eight floors to uncover the unsettling truth that waits below. MULTIPLE ENDINGS The story doesn't end with just one playthrough. Replay the game to find all the anomalies. Each anomaly is a key that brings you closer to the truth. There are three main endings. From the developer:  This is a free game made with love, if you’d like to support future development, take a look at my other titles.
row.short_description: You are trapped in a Sunday School, plagued by eerie childlike hallucinations. Observe your surroundings carefully to spot anomalies, and descend deeper only when you’re certain it’s safe.

row.name: 九州青云劫
row.detailed_description: 踏入九州，飞升青云。你的仙侠长生之路，即将开启。 《九州青云劫》——破界飞升，开启你的东方仙侠MMO大世界 《九州青云劫》是一款以东方玄幻为核心的开放世界仙侠 MMORPG。游戏以壮阔的九州大陆为舞台，融合轻功探索、角色养成、多人副本、跨服战场、社交互动、结婚系统等典型 MMO 玩法，带来媲美 .黑色沙漠.天谕.古剑奇谭网络版.Elder Scrolls Online. 的沉浸式大世界体验。 在这片充满灵气的东方大陆上，云海山川、洞天福地、仙岛古城彼此交织，呈现出一个宏大而立体的玄幻世界。无论你喜欢开放式冒险还是偏好F14式的团队副本战斗，又或是热衷黑沙式的角色外观系统，都能在《九州青云劫》中找到乐趣。 ■ 四大职业 · 觉醒变身，战斗更具张力 游戏拥有多个极具东方特色的职业，例如龙诀、碎梦、神意、翎羽等，每个职业都具备独特技能与专属觉醒形态。 当觉醒冷却结束后，你将获得全新的外形与强化战力，让战斗体验更加畅快、更加激烈。 战斗节奏融合了 MMO 的自由走位与技能连携.动作元素，使每一次攻防都充满力量感。 ■ 侍灵·坐骑·翅膀 · 千种外观任你选择 《九州青云劫》构建了极为庞大的外观系统，可自由养成： 侍灵伙伴：可进阶、装备、幻化 威武坐骑：可提升移动、增加属性、自由幻化 华丽翅膀：酷炫外观 + 战力双提升 法宝、影刃、仙盾、披风：形态多变、战力增强 这些外观系统在玩法上与.黑色沙漠.的自定义外观、装备幻化、.天谕.的外观多样性有相似特点，让玩家在仙侠世界中实现真正的“自由外形构建”。 ■ 深度装备与进阶系统 · 打造属于你的道法神装 游戏搭载完善的装备循环系统：装备强化、洗练、升阶、宝石镶嵌、觉醒装备、天神套装等，让你在成长过程中不断突破自我。 灵器、法宝等系统可带来强大的被动技能，让战斗策略更加多样化。 对喜欢“刷装备、肝战力” 的 MMORGP 玩家来说，《九州青云劫》提供了足够深度与耐玩性。 *■ 多人副本与跨服对战 · 热血PVP与合作PVE全覆盖 丰富的副本系统包括： * 主线副本 * 组队副本 * 天神副本 * 帮派BOSS * 试炼塔 * 限时活动副本 与好友一同挑战强力BOSS，获得稀有掉落。 在跨服战场中，你可与来自不同服务器的高手切磋，在帮派战、跨服争霸、仙魔战场中夺取至高荣耀。 这种设计类似 .逆水寒.剑灵.战场. 的跨区玩法，让竞争更加激烈。 ■ 社交 · 姻缘 · 换装 · 轻功探索，一个真正的“修仙人生” 除了战斗，《九州青云劫》还提供沉浸式生活体验： 社交系统：好友、帮派、真人语聊 结婚系统：举办婚宴、获得情侣装备与专属副本 宝宝系统：独有武器与护盾，陪伴成长 轻功探索：飞檐走壁、御剑飞行，探索九州山海 喜欢轻松社交与角色扮演（RolePlay）的玩家能找到最真实的仙侠生活。 ■ 适合以下玩家： 如果你喜欢： ✔ 东方玄幻世界 ✔ 仙侠MMO ✔ 开放世界冒险（Open World） ✔ 丰富外观系统（Fashion / Cosmetic） ✔ 团队副本 + 大型PVP ✔ ESO、黑色沙漠、天谕、逆水寒、剑灵、古剑奇谭、FF14 等玩法 那么《九州青云劫》将是你全新的归宿。
row.short_description: 《九州青云劫》是一款东方仙侠开放世界 MMORPG，结合轻功探索、多人副本、跨服 PVP、自由交易、外观时装、坐骑侍灵与角色觉醒系统。体验国风玄幻大世界、御剑飞行、修仙冒险、帮派社交与沉浸式动作 RPG 战斗。

row.name: DarkOrbit Reloaded
row.detailed_description: Humanity’s reckless use of Jump Gates triggered a brutal alien retaliation that almost annihilated Earth. In the aftermath, three rival conglomerates emerged: Earth Industries Corporation (EIC), Mars Mining Operations (MMO), and Venus Resources Unlimited (VRU). For generations, their strife has cloaked  the stars in a never-ending fog of war!   Dark Orbit is a long-running free-to-play space MMO. Join the fray today and battle for dominance across a fractured galaxy alongside millions of players!   CHOOSE YOUR ALLEGIANCE and become an elite pilot! CUSTOMIZE YOUR SHIP from a wide variety of designs, outfitting it with drones, weapons, generators, and specialized equipment. TRADE VALUABLE RESOURCES like Prometium, Endurium, Terbium and many more! BID ON ELITE ITEMS and auction off spare loot to gain the upper hand! EPIC MAIN QUEST: Explore the dark history behind the three conglomerates and uncover a galactic conspiracy threatening the fabric of the whole universe! THE LORDAKIA ARE WATCHING: Encounter a wide variety of alien species from all over the universe! BUILD GALAX GATES to access hidden sectors and make your way through a whole new galaxy! Uncover RARE REWARDS! VISIT YOUR SKYLAB to allocate resources and fine-tune your gameplay strategy!   Whether you're diving into PvP combat or tackling PvE missions, DarkOrbit offers a sprawling universe filled with danger, intrigue, and opportunity. Will you rise through the ranks and lead your company beyond the final frontier?
row.short_description: Dark Orbit is a free-2-play space MMO where three companies battle for galactic domination. Customize ships, trade resources, fight aliens and uncover a grand conspiracy on your epic cosmic journey. Thrilling PvP and PvE missions await! Will you lead your faction beyond the final frontier?

row.name: GALIX: New horizons 星海乐章 Playtest
Ressolve Steps
row.detailed_description: The goal of this game is to step on checkpoint tiles in the level and return to your respawn point. Press R for respawn. When you step on any tiles (except the respawn point) and move on to another tile, the previously stepped tile will dissolve. When you step on the checkpoint tile (black tile) and make the tile dissolve, the checkpoint's remaining number on the top left will decrease. Once you dissolve all of the checkpoints in the level, the stripe color of the respawn will change to green. Stepping it grants you access to the next level. From level 2, you can place a tile by clicking the cell; however, each level has a limited number of tiles you can place, so be careful.
row.short_description: A simple 3D top-down puzzle game that requires precise movement and strategy.

row.name: Loser Named Hana
row.detailed_description: About You have found a strange ad at your local convenience store advertising $100 a week to be someone’s friend. The catch? The girl is an incredibly lonely girl named “Hana” with a strange, high-pitched voice. Regardless of how you treat Hana, one thing is for certain: she is desperate for friendship. Your New Friend Hana Mendoza Birthday: October 13th 1999 Sexuality: Desperate (bi/pan) Gender: Cis Woman She/Her Age: 19 Height: 5’3’’ Personality: Sensitive, Clumsy, Lonely Occupation: College Student Features Ability to play as cis, trans, or various other genders  (She/Her, They/Them, He/Him) 25K words of girl failure interaction About an hour and a half of gameplay 3 Endings Partially voiced Ability to mute voice acting
row.short_description: Loser Named Hana is a friendship-building visual novel. You respond to an ad advertising $100 a week to be the lonely college student, Hana, friend.

row.name: RATMOUSE
row.detailed_description: RATMOUSE is a fast-paced, challenging, arcade style romp where you play as a RAT, with your MOUSE (see what i did there?) Guide Barbra the rat through several NASTY, dilapidated, harsh environments INFESTED with bugs, its your job to clear them out, and eat some crumbs while you're at it. Think fast, move faster. RATMOUSE captures the spirit of many classic phase based arcade games, while twisting it into something new. Every stage is hand-crafted, every animation drawn frame by frame, and every second pushes you to stay as sharp as the knife you wield.
row.short_description: it's rat vs roach in this arcade style romp... RATMOUSE is a fast-paced, challenging, arcade style romp where you play as a RAT, with your MOUSE (get it yet?)
row.reviews: “connected deeply with this adventure, i value this game more than human life...” 4.6/12 – XxRATMOUSE_Fan2003xX

row.name: Warriors Across Worlds
row.detailed_description: Get ready for the next generation of Warriors! After a brutal battle with a new threat, three Warriors are separated and are forced to survive in strange, new worlds with only their wits about them. They’ll meet familiar faces and fight alongside them in an attempt to stop the Desolate Demon from combining the Desolate Dimension with their dimension. Featuring fact-paced, turn-based JRPG combat and an explosive soundtrack you’re sure to remember; this is a JRPG that’s gonna take you on a wild ride. Features: Three main playable characters that put in work and three supporting characters that provide their own benefits and keep the main characters mentally sane during their adventure. Explore the mysterious worlds of Zuld, Meelon, Even Newer York, and the Floating Islands. You’ll get to see a forest, a prison, the equivalent of Hell, some islands, the future, poison swamps, the inside of something, and a prism world. Over 100 new attacks! Each one is flashier than the last. A lot of banter between characters that’ll make you laugh. There’s even side-conversations that’ll randomly appear now and again. Animated cutscenes! Several segments of the story are fully animated to help better immerse the player. A soundtrack of over 50 songs composed by me! I hope you like drum & bass! 7 difficulty options! If you want a leisurely stroll or an absolute onslaught, this game has you covered. (W.M.D. is ONLY meant for JRPG experts. Maybe even beyond expert, like super-expert.) Over 40 achievements! Can you collect them all? View artwork of the characters, battle backgrounds, and moments from the story in the Gallery! EP Styles: Select from 10 different styles to best fit your playstyle and help you perform devastating, ultimate attacks! (Beyond the standard 9999 maximum, you get to see the exact amount of damage you inflict). Six new, unique classes! Wield the power of Space, Time, Doom, Dread, Blood, and Storm!  An Enemy Guide that shows you every detail about an enemy with special dialogue for each one! Wanna move faster? Just Boost with a press of a button! All of that and more awaits you in this badass JRPG!
row.short_description: Even When Separated, Miracles Can Happen. A short, indie JRPG about what happens when the dimension's strongest team gets split apart. They'll meet new friends and foes...mostly foes.
row.notes: There's a lot of swearing. Like a LOT. There's also a chapter that's dedicated to being kind of creepy with mildly disturbing imagery. The imagery includes: Blood, Large Eyes, and the fact that you're in the insides of a creature.

row.name: Shadow Of Winter
row.detailed_description: Winter, 1985. A storm forces an emergency landing deep in the Canadian wilderness. You are Joseph, a young man stranded in the snow with no way out and one mission: find your missing brother. The search leads you to a place long forgotten, an abandoned Soviet military bunker, sealed away beneath the ice. What begins as a rescue quickly becomes a fight for survival. The bunker isn’t empty. Its halls are scarred with roots that push through steel, its silence broken by something that moves when you’re not looking. Every room holds fragments of its past: Cold War paranoia, failed experiments, and a story buried under layers of secrecy. As you descend deeper, you must: Survive the Elements – Manage limited supplies, craft essential tools, and endure the harsh winter pressing in from above. Explore and Uncover – Search through detailed Soviet-era environments filled with journals, notes, and relics that reveal the fate of the facility. Face the Horrors Below – Evade twisted creatures and environmental hazards that stalk the dark. Solve and Adapt – Restore power, bypass locked systems, and use your wits to push further into the unknown. This is not a fight you win with firepower. Every decision matters. Every step forward carries risk. The deeper you go, the closer you come to uncovering the truth - and the cost of survival.
row.short_description: A narrative-driven survival horror set in the frozen wilderness of 1985. Descend into an abandoned Soviet bunker, uncover its dark secrets, and fight to survive the terrors lurking within.
row.notes: The player can act out violent acts towards the in game fantasy horror monster such as shooting and or burning the monster to death.

row.name: Fire flies
row.detailed_description: Fireflies is a 3D adventure healing game set in a world where light and darkness intertwine. As a small spirit searching for lost lights, players journey through a forest that shifts between day and night — bringing brightness back to a lake swallowed by darkness. Time in this world has stopped in an endless night. The only thing that can illuminate the sky is the faint glow of the fireflies that have lost their light. Yet, during brief moments when day breaks through, the world reveals hidden landscapes and truths that cannot be seen in the dark. Gameplay Ability to switch between day and night , revealing new paths and secrets. Emotionally immersive atmosphere with gentle lighting and sound. Nature-based platforming that blends exploration and environmental interaction. Progression & Objective Players explore the forest, completing objectives in each area as they follow the path guided by mysterious mushrooms. Playtime Approximately 15 minutes for the main story. Genre & Features Genre: 3D Adventure / Exploration / Healing / Platformer Mode: Single-player / Keyboard supported Soundtrack: Original acoustic and emotional background music A small light wandering through the darkness — and at the end of that journey, the story of finding one’s true self.
row.short_description: Explore a serene world where light and darkness intertwine. As a tiny firefly spirit, journey through a quiet forest, switching between day and night to reveal hidden paths and restore brightness to a darkened lake.

row.name: Cosmic Cargo
row.detailed_description: Embark on a daring journey in 'Cosmic Cargo,' a thrilling space adventure where you're the architect and captain of your own spacecraft. Carry cargo from station to station while fending off enemies and avoiding stellar hazards, using your spoils to upgrade your vessel into a formidable space fortress. Each run promises a thrilling path to becoming the ultimate cosmic courier in a galaxy teeming with risks and rewards! Modular, tile-based ship building that encourages creativity and requires strategy to ensure survival. Five main levels with three difficulty settings , and an endless mode that lets you test how far your ship can go! Face a wide variety of enemies and environmental hazards. You will face increasing risks - and rewards! More money means a bigger ship with more cargo and even more guns! With each successful delivery earn more for each cargo block your ship carries. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Embark on a daring journey in 'Cosmic Cargo,' a thrilling space adventure where you're the architect and captain of your own spacecraft. Carry cargo from station to station while fending off enemies and avoiding stellar hazards.

row.name: Serene Night Dreamlight
row.detailed_description: NOTE: English is NOT currently fully supported. As for now, only GUI (text of the main story not included) is supported in English. Full translation will be available soon, please stay tuned. Story Introduction Dreama, an otaku girl constantly torn between her love for anime, daily routines, and last-minute assignments, never imagined her life would be completely turned around by a limited-edition poster blown away by the wind. On that late autumn afternoon, she met a mysterious girl named Lyra on the cherry blossom-lined path in the park. A first encounter over a poster and a shared 'duty' in the library became the starting point of their bond. From their casual chats during library work, the heart-racing moment of an accidental fall in the storage room, the warmth of sharing a red umbrella in the rain, to the dazzling sunset glow during their confession. Two contrasting souls gradually drew closer amidst exam papers, homework, club rumors, and the confusion of youth. Here, there are no complicated relationships or heavy family burdens. Just the pure and authentic daily life belonging to these girls in their youth. Being punished for not memorizing English vocabulary, getting caught playing Gomoku during evening self-study, feeling their hearts flutter at a confession under the romantic sunset, feeling bewildered and overwhelmed by the other's radiance, and finally rushing recklessly toward the stage after acknowledging their true feelings. When ideals collide with romance, when confusion about the future intertwines with present courage. Can they run toward each other once more, and let the spring cherry blossoms bloom for them again? Features 150,000-word script with multiple endings Lighthearted, slice-of-life stories Created by high school students, filled with authentic high school details Character Introduction Dreama Mung Lyra Ye
row.short_description: A game made by 5 high-school students, is finally here! This is short yuri-themed galgame which tells a story between two high school girls. Please forget your worries and enjoy this beautiful yuri world.

row.name: 古惑仔：風雲再起

row.detailed_description: Dilemma Dungeon is a 4-player co-op top-down roguelike dungeon exploration game. To overcome the cursed dungeon, players must work together, but every choice comes at a cost. At every moment of combat and growth, players face choices: will you become stronger yourself, or sacrifice for your allies? You may raise your own stats significantly at the cost of lowering a teammate’s, or make someone else stronger while weakening yourself. The game consists of three stages, and with ever-changing room layouts, monsters, and events, each run is a brand new challenge. Players complete their own builds by combining different classes, skills, and equipment items, and must break the curse to reach the end of the dungeon. In this dungeon, where cooperation and betrayal, sacrifice and greed intertwine—can you maintain trust with your teammates until the very end?
row.short_description: A co-op roguelike dungeon exploration game. Each run, you must create builds by combining different maps, classes, skills, and items, and overcome the cursed dungeon.

hackSociety
row.detailed_description: hackSociety is an immersive, online hacking simulator. In a persistent online world, you'll explore a unique array of opportunities and gameplay paths as a hacker. It modernizes the old, dead genre of 'click hack, steal their money, repeat'. You'll build custom exploits and malware, make them work and bypass antivirus detection, and pick what you want to specialize in. Do you want to get into the crypto market? Steal it from your victims, or would you rather harvest your compromised systems into a botnet and mine it instead? Or keep your laundered funds safer in a bank account, with less risk? Or maybe mining crypto doesn't interest you, and you'd rather use your botnet to DDoS other organizations and win territorial disputes with those who dare stand against you and your crew. A lot is possible in this world. Will you be one of the greats who makes a name for themselves, or will you be washed away? Play for Free today and begin your journey in hackSociety. Features Viruses & Exploits - Just like in the real world, malware comes in strains. Named, categorized threats. In this game, it's no different. You'll choose what you are creating, name it, and unleash it strategically on targets you think are vulnerable. You can't be careless. Messing with the wrong people will quickly get your virus detected. It would be smart to scan your targets before attacking to gauge where their defenses are vulnerable. If you are prominent and powerful enough, your virus and its name will become infamous. Simulated Environment - The world reacts to you. The in-game crypto market is dynamic and always moving. Invest in the long term, and you can become leagues richer than your enemies. Collectible hNFT items are like property, with varying supply and rarity. You'll trade, auction, and barter with real people trying to control a live market to make even more money and premium currency. The better you are at it, the more gameplay buffs and powers you can acquire unique to most others. Manage a Botnet - Pool your compromised systems together and use their processing power for your own. Mine crypto, use the power to defend yourself from attacks, or go offensive and use the power in coordinated DDoS attacks with your organization. Organizations & Social - hackSociety is a very social game. Making friends and working with people you know can make or break you. Organization Tournaments pay out in heaps, with premium currency you'll need to upgrade your tools. It also doesn't hurt to have your name attached to the most fearsome, powerful organizations around on the network. You'll customize your profile to your liking, and flex your inventory and status with it in the in-game chat. Defenses - You're a target too. In hackSociety, you'll need to learn how to keep yourself safe from people like yourself. Firewall, antivirus, drive encryption, and your opsec will all keep your system safe in their own way. You'll learn while playing that nothing is a catch-all. A good antivirus isn't a magic shield, and an intensive firewall has its own weaknesses. Live Service - You can expect lots of gameplay updates and extensions of the game. The possibilities are endless with a thorough hacking simulator like hackSociety, and you and the community control the future of the game. Suggest what you think would be cool to implement into the game on our socials like the Discord, or in-game. There's more for you to explore, and we'll leave that up to you for when the game is released. Wishlist hackSociety and be there first!
row.short_description: hackSociety is an immersive MMO hacking simulator. Become part of a living, breathing simulated society in the most thorough and expansive hacker sim ever made. Will you become a legend, or fade into obscurity?

row.name: Grid Wipe
row.detailed_description: Grid Wipe is a puzzle game where you clear a grid by adding or subtracting numbers. Each move affects a selected cell and its orthogonal neighbors, requiring careful planning to complete the puzzle.  Manipulate Numbers: Select a cell to add or subtract from it and its orthogonal neighbors. Constraints: You cannot add to a cell or neighbor if any of them is already at the maximum value (5). You cannot subtract from a cell or neighbor if any of them is already at 0. Goal: Clear all numbers from the grid, leaving every cell blank. Features: Minimalistic, grid-based design that focuses on strategy and logic. Puzzles are short and self-contained, making them easy to pick up at any time. Logical challenges that require thinking several steps ahead. Choose from 3 grid sizes (5x5, 7x7, 9x9) Choose game difficulty; easy, medium or hard
row.short_description: Grid Wipe is a puzzle game where you clear a grid by adding or subtracting numbers. Each move affects a selected cell and its orthogonal neighbors, requiring careful planning to complete the puzzle.

row.name: Spirit Guide
row.detailed_description: Postures change your attitude and decisions. Each posture is chosen randomly—but remember, God controls randomness and is everyone’s true Spirit Guide. You can do the postures sitting, standing, stepping, lying down , or even use the app to fall asleep to . Let the movements guide you, one moment at a time. What's fascinating about this game is how Spirit guides your Attitude by choosing a Posture at a particular Time. If you should be more CONFIDENT, the posture is Up Front. If you should be more HUMBLE about something, the posture is Back Down. If you should be more THOUGHTFUL about an issue, the posture is Back Up. If Spirit feels you need to be more GROUNDED, the posture is Down Front. And so on. There are 9 postures, which SHIFT YOUR ATTITUDE, making you more HONEST AND BALANCED in your mental state with respect to the issues in your mind. This app is good exercise, because, while you are doing the arm postures, you are standing up and sitting down, taking steps, and IMPROVING YOUR POSTURE by standing and sitting straight. So, it is a good Mind + Body exercise. This app differs from other MIND BODY AWARE GAMES LLC offerings in that it is more direct and doesn't use Element Language (Water, Wind, Fire, Ground/Earth) for the posture names, just the direction relative to the body. The main menu has: (1) About this App, (2) Sit or Stand (video), (3) Taking Steps (video), (4) Move Meditate, (5) Move/Center, (6) Qigong, (7) A Short Routine, (8) A Game In the Game, you use the keyboard to pose the avatar, and get a point for each posture you correctly pose for. It is fun! But this app is also subtle, and you have to be quiet and introspective to feel the PRESENCE OF SPIRIT GUIDING YOU ACCORDING TO WHAT IS IN YOUR MIND. Otherwise, it just seems like random movements. Thank you!

You can do the postures sitting, standing, stepping, lying down, or even use the app to fall asleep to. Let the movements guide you.

With fast paced action, your strategy must be ever evolving to vanquish your enemies.  Engaging, Story-rich Campaign Experience a world broken by war with one hope of redemption. But his greatest enemy is closer than he ever believed. 90+ Original Characters From the ever-warring nations of the Dohoda Heroes must arise amidst the chaos that plagues the land. Follow the stories of the loyal General Benaiah, the hopeful peasant Eloria, and other Heroes that will shape the future of their land and hearts, for good or ill. Each must make their own choice in the turbulent times, to choose between might or morality. Test Your Merit in Challenges Fight in epic duels to the death with expedited combat. Master your magic in a place that denies physical means of weaponry. Prove your worth by fighting the legendary Titan of Might, Kiros. Explore the forests of Muros, filled with powerful enemies, while earning artifacts of ancient strength. Experiment with a Plethora of Teams Lead your Heroes into action with a myriad of team combinations. From the uniform Humans of Arktiria, to the devious Dark Elves of Mavros, use cunning swordplay or mystical wizardry to defeat your adversaries. With a vast roster to choose from, you decide which synergies to explore.
row.short_description: Experience a world broken by war with one hope of redemption. Follow the tale of a general whose loyalty is put to the test when his kingdom is thrown into shambles. Friends may become enemies, and enemies may turn to friends.

row.name: Palmier Island
row.detailed_description: PALMIER ISLAND is a cozy island RPG sim that tricks you into learning French through pure play and no curriculum. Plot: The economy is in shambles, and you're fresh outta college with no job and no prospects, so you fly to your millionaire uncle's island to catsit for the summer. However, when you arrive, you find out that all the islanders only speak French and you have to pay off your missing uncle's debt! Start a cafe, run a farm, fight demons in a school basement, go to court, and more as you discover each islander's lore and leave the island semi-fluent! Core Gameplay Mechanic: Learn French through our core gameplay mechanic, Chattle, which is like a Pokemon battle where your words are Pokemon. You capture words from the Chattle into your vocabulary to navigate each conversational puzzle.  Minigames: Test your guessing skills through multiple minigames, such as shopping with only French labels, baking treats by recognizing vocabulary, and exploring alternative Chattle routes.
row.short_description: Cozy island RPG sim... but everyone only speaks French and you have to pay off your missing uncle's debt! Start a cafe, run a farm, fight demons in a school basement, go to court, and more as you discover each islander's lore and leave the island semi-fluent!

row.name: Archival Anemoia
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Archival Anemoia , an archive of over 30 different games made over the course of around 13 years, all by one girl in her childhood, and all for free! Archival Anemoia is a collection and museum of all sorts of different games by Mireille Scieppan over the span of a decade, as a celebration of Creatalsoftware's 10 year anniversary. From small prototypes and experimental learning projects to fully featured experiences with an overarching story, this bundles nearly every single game released under Creatalsoftware and then some. Several of the games have seen some improvements for this collection with being remastered or having additional quality of life added, helping modernize and bring more life into them. Features Over 30 different games across several different genres Several older games and projects made playable for the first time in years Some games games remastered or updated with new art, quality of life features, and bug fixes Several scrapped projects and prototypes, with many never before seen Information about the development of every game and scrapped project in the tour New arrangements of songs from the games in the collection Several different UI themes, with extras that can be unlocked based on save completion of Garenburg Woods or Garenburg Penitence Tons and tons of concept art made throughout the years Want to know what goes into making a game? Included with the collection is a museum tour giving developer commentary, context and background to all these games, with a retrospective years later on the process of making them. Insight into the development of games released separately from this collection, such as Garenburg Woods , Garenburg Penitence: The Riflebird , and  bygone snow , is also included. And to top it off are a bunch of concept art, info on scrapped ideas and prototypes for various other projects over the years! Charmolypi (2023) After a young and mysterious girl named Castranom arrives at a small hut near a lake occupied by recluse Afeil, the two begin a friendship and find solace in each other. As Castranom learns to fish at the lake, watch as the two grow closer and their own past come to light in a short little fishing game. A short and sweet fishing game that can be completed in a small amount of time. The game was originally made in a little under 2 weeks, but this re-release includes brand new artwork and fish to find. A spinoff of the Garenburg series. Kiffen & Maintane (2022) Help Kiffen & Maintane build a little house in a platforming experience, with online multiplayer support for up to four people! Gather materials and explore a small little world at your own leisure! The Möbius Strip (2019) A scientist, famous for making a sense-enhancing innovation, is recruited to work for the Silver Bed Foundation on a new project: a way to make immortality real. A short puzzle RPG with three major acts. Now including a built-in hints system for puzzles, and higher quality portraits. Part of the Garenburg series. Garenburg Penitence: Juniper Originally, the game Garenburg Penitence: The Riflebird was going to have a N3DS demake with unique levels, but it was scrapped back in 2022 with the console reaching its end of life. Now, take a look into the scrapped N3DS game with Garenburg Penitence: Juniper , ported back to PC and available to play exclusively through this collection! And more! Take a dive into several other projects, such as horror-puzzle RPG  Limp , the puzzle platformer  Twisted Mirror  and its sequel and remake, the 49 page story 'Project Gwenevere,' short stories and novellas from the Garenburg series, and much more! By no means are the games in this collection masterpieces. There are a lot of pretty badly made games in this set. But they were all made for fun and with a lot of love put into them, and are brought here to immortalize them in this bizarre little bundle. They aren't the bestest of games, but I hope you have fun taking a look at the weird stuff that's been made over the years in this collection. Thank you!!!
row.short_description: Welcome to Archival Anemoia, an archive of over 30 different games made over the course of around 13 years, all by one girl in her childhood, and all for free!
row.notes: Most of the games in this collection are tame, but some have a focus on more mature content and topics. Additionally, the Museum Tour, which has development commentary, talks about these themes and topics in greater detail as well as intent.

row.name: Immortal: And The Death That Follows Playtest
엉덩이 밀기! (Assslash!)
row.detailed_description: We're excited to introduce you to a completely new kind of action game today. Get ready for the  Assslash! — The Butt-Bumping Bishōjo Battle Action Game ,  set against the vibrant backdrop of Korea —a game unlike anything you've ever played! This game is more than just a fighting game. Cute and distinctive bishōjo characters engage in a thrilling butt-bumping showdown in real-time across vibrant 3D environments! The combination of an eccentric concept and a deep storyline provides an exhilarating new action experience you've never encountered before. Core Game Features and Mechanics (Game Mechanics) This is a 1v1 casual action game that anyone can easily pick up and enjoy, regardless of complex controls. Full 3D Battle Action: Experience dynamic, real-time combat by directly controlling characters in gorgeous Unreal engine 5's 3D graphics . Casual Controls: Forget complex command inputs! All combat revolves around just two key actions: Dodge and Butt-Bump . We focused on the satisfying 'feel of the push' as you forcefully shove your opponent with a single button press. Unique Concept: This cheerful and original concept of settling scores with butts offers unexpected moments of reversal, bringing players both great laughter and excitement. Game Goal and Plot (Goal & Story) Dive into a bizarre yet profound story unfolding in the fictional city of Dalgu . Main Goal: Players team up with the NIS (National Intelligence Service) of Korea to punish the city's immoral and wicked individuals using the power of the butt . Solve the Mystery: Unravel the secrets behind the mysterious Butt-Rage Phenomenon sweeping the city and stop your friends who have been driven mad by this power. Deep Narrative: Beyond simple comedic action, the story delves into a profound and two-sided narrative as you confront a greater dark conspiracy lurking in the background. Main Challenges (Challenges) Can you defeat every enemy using only the power of the butt? Diverse Enemy Characters: A variety of enemies, each with their own traits and misdeeds, await you—from a School Principal and a Local Church Pastor to friends who have succumbed to the Butt-Rage. Special Attack Patterns: Every enemy character possesses unique attack patterns . Players must read and dodge these patterns and counter-attack using only the Butt-Bump control. Extreme Challenge: You'll even face enemies who wield guns . Can you truly decipher and destroy all enemy patterns using nothing but your butt and quick reflexes? Character Progression System (Character Progression) Experience new gameplay every time with a growth system featuring randomized elements. Random Supply Drops: After clearing each stage, you'll receive a supply drop from Officer Yook to help your character grow. Random Stat Growth: Your character possesses four stats: STR (Strength) , CON (Concentration) , LUK (Luck) , and SPD (Speed) . Receiving the random supply drops means these stats will grow randomly . Infinite Replayability: Since your character develops differently with every attempt, you'll enjoy a roguelike sense of fun and face a new challenge each time you play. Playtime and Sound (Playtime & Full-Sound) Standard Playtime: The standard playthrough for the core story and missions provides a highly immersive experience lasting approximately 1 hour to 1 hour and 30 minutes . Complete Korean Voice Acting: Nearly all dialogue from the characters has been completely recorded in Korean . Experience the passionate performances of the amazing voice actors and dive deeper into the story! Supported Languages (Support Languages) This game supports translation for global players in four languages: Korean , Japanese , English , and Spanish . - The moment you push your opponent away with a simple button press, you'll feel both awe and laughter! With comical attacks and unpredictable comeback moments, playing with friends, family, or partners is sure to create some truly fun memories.
row.short_description: Everyone, 'This isn't just a fight.' Get ready for the spectacular sight of adorable cute girls pushing each other off vibrant, flashy 3D stages using their 'Ultimate Butt Push' techniques. Download now and show off your 'Ultimate ASSS Power!' (Don't forget to time your moves just right.)

row.name: Miiridian Prime
row.detailed_description: Enter the world of Miiridian Prime, a free-to-play, class-based third-person PvP battle arena set in a striking science-fantasy universe. Every hero is unique, with their own class, abilities, and combat style, and victory belongs only to those who adapt, master their playstyle, and outthink their rivals. EARLY ACCESS BETA This is the Early Access Beta version of Miiridian Prime — an evolving experience where your feedback and participation will help shape the future of the game . During this phase, players can expect regular updates introducing new heroes, arenas, and gameplay features , as well as ongoing balance adjustments and performance improvements. Join early, share your insights, and become part of the community defining what Miiridian Prime will become. MASTER THE ART OF HEROES Miiridian Prime features nine unique heroes , each with their own class, combat style, and set of abilities. No hero is alike — every champion carries a distinct role on the battlefield and a different path to victory. All heroes wield both melee and ranged weapons, creating powerful combinations for every encounter. Some rely on speed and aggression, others on strategy and battlefield control, while a few stand as the unbreakable shield of their team. With every update, new heroes, abilities, and playstyles will expand the roster — keeping the game fresh and every battle unforgettable. MOVEMENT AS A WEAPON Verticality defines combat in Miiridian Prime. The grappling hook changes how you approach every fight — helping you escape danger, close in on distant opponents, seize high ground, or strike from unexpected angles. True mastery lies not only in combat but also in movement. Those who control space, control the outcome. CHOOSE YOUR BATTLEFIELD Miiridian Prime delivers multiple ways to prove your skill: Free-for-all battles with up to 8 players, where survival is the only law. 4v4 team clashes that reward coordination and smart tactics. 1v1 duels — the ultimate showdown, hero against hero, with nowhere to hide. Objective-driven encounters where capturing zones and completing missions under pressure is the key to victory. Each mode challenges you in different ways, pushing your adaptability and keeping every fight fresh. EVOLVING ARENAS Arenas are more than just backdrops — they shape the flow of combat. Collapsing bridges, explosive traps, and shifting terrain demand constant adaptation, turning the battlefield itself into a weapon. PROGRESSION & STYLE Forge your legacy with progression and customization: Unlock new heroes and abilities Climb competitive leaderboards Personalize your champions with distinctive skins and cosmetics Every match brings progress, rewards, and new ways to stand out. A LIVING, SURREAL WORLD Miiridian Prime blends surreal beauty with impossible architecture: Floating islands and ancient ruins steeped in mystery Striking visuals and reactive effects that bring combat to life A hybrid electronic-orchestral soundtrack that intensifies the action Impactful sound design that makes every clash feel real JOIN THE FIGHT Miiridian Prime is constantly evolving, with new heroes, arenas, and features added regularly. Step into the surreal battlefield, master your class, and claim your place among legends.
row.short_description: Miiridian Prime is a free-to-play class-based third-person PvP arena where nine unique heroes battle across surreal arenas, combining melee and ranged combat, vertical movement, and team strategy.

row.name: Gilroy's Grove
row.detailed_description: The forest won’t give up its secrets easily. monstrous creatures stand between you and the truth behind the corruption. Cut down what blocks your path, uncover hidden items, and unlock new areas within the forest. Your land is corrupting. Fight back with your shovel, your wits, and the seeds left behind by your enemies. Grow, harvest, and turn the plant life into your weapons. The forest doesn't just have corrupted creatures but also has towering bosses that stand in your way. Each boss is a twisted part of the curse, with unique mechanics and devastating attacks.  -3 Regions to explore-  -3 Bosses to fights-  -3 New plants to fight per region-  -A bunch of questionable weapons-
row.short_description: Step into the forest where your shovel is both your weapon and lifeline. Fight back against twisted forest creatures, claim their corrupted seeds, and bring them to your farm and grow your weapons. Restore the forest plant by plant, Will you break the curse, or will the forest claim you too?

row.name: 深渊旅人
row.detailed_description: An ordinary rural boy, with an unexpected rescue, opens the prelude to a conspiracy to overthrow the world. Abyssal Traveler is a traditional turn based role-playing game that emphasizes story and character development. You will lead the protagonist Sauron and the mysterious girl Yuna on an adventure through a vast world, uncovering the ultimate secret hidden between the kingdom and the gods through growth and decision-making. [Core Features] 🎭 Immersive storyline experience -Experience a thrilling journey from ordinary to legendary, and your choices will influence the direction of the story. -Through a large number of rich side quests, gain a deep understanding of every corner and character's past in this world. ⚔️ Classic and strategic turn based battles -Adopting classic command based combat: flexibly using skills, attacks, and items to defeat enemies. -As you level up, learn powerful new skills and customize your combat style. 👥 Recruiting and cultivating unique partners -Encounter and recruit partners with diverse abilities: experienced hunters, fierce warriors, sacred church priests, etc. -Focus on cultivating partners based on their different characteristics, strategically match team formations, and deal with various powerful monsters and bosses. 🌍 Explore diverse fantasy worlds -Embark on an adventurous journey through dense virgin forests, magnificent monasteries, sandy deserts, and other unique regions. [Main role] -Soren: A sunny and determined rural boy who bravely ventures into the unknown world with a sword and shield to protect his loved ones. -Yuna: An amnesiac girl with a mysterious background, possessing powerful magic. Her memory is the key to solving all puzzles.
row.short_description: A traditional Japanese-style turn-based RPG driven by plot. Assemble a unique adventure team, unravel the mystery of a girl's amnesia in a vast fantasy world, and reverse the fate of the world. Experience an epic tale of heroes intertwined with conspiracies and divine games. QQ group: 1032905256

row.detailed_description: 关注Author王异的B站账号谢谢喵！加入官方群组谢谢喵！ 你说的对，但是《王异工坊FanCraft》是由Author王异自主研发的一款开源、格斗、肉鸽、二次元的缝合游戏。 为了凑字数，以下介绍内容用AI生成。 核心玩法：格斗与肉鸽的完美融合 在《王异工坊FanCraft》中，玩家将进入一个充满敌人、陷阱和未知的世界。游戏采用肉鸽玩法，每局游戏都在随机中展开。每一局的敌人、道具乃至战斗方式都不同，让你每次游戏都有全新的体验。 你将与形形色色的敌人战斗，并不断收集不同的技能、装备和武器。随着挑战的深入，敌人会变得越来越强大，玩家需要通过精妙的操作和策略来战胜他们。每个角色都有独特的技能和成长，允许你根据自己的喜好与战斗风格定制自己的角色。 丰富的角色与技能系统 《王异工坊FanCraft》提供了多个可玩角色，每个角色都有各自的技能与特色。你可以自由选择不同的角色进行冒险，享受完全不同的战斗体验。角色的成长是游戏的核心之一，通过战斗积累经验，购买新的技能，形成独特的战斗风格。 游戏中的商店系统也是多样化的，你可以选择强化攻击或者提升防御。每个角色可以通过不同的道具进一步增强，使每一次选择都充满战略性。 二次元风格的视觉体验 游戏的画面采用精美的二次元风格，让每场战斗都显得充满活力。战斗中，不仅仅是你和敌人之间的较量，游戏中的世界本身也会通过独特的视觉效果、动态场景和互动元素，让你沉浸在一个充满幻想和创意的虚拟世界中。 开源与社区支持 作为一款开源游戏，《王异工坊FanCraft》欢迎玩家与开发者一起参与游戏的改进和扩展。游戏的工程文件完全开放，玩家可以自由修改和自定义内容，甚至可以贡献新的功能和游戏模式，打造属于自己的独特版本。 总结 《王异工坊FanCraft》是一款集格斗、肉鸽、二次元元素于一身的独特游戏。通过精心设计的战斗系统、角色成长机制和丰富的玩法模式，游戏提供了极高的可玩性与自由度。无论你是什么类型的玩家，都能在这款游戏中找到属于自己的乐趣。现在就加入《王异工坊FanCraft》，开始你的冒险之旅吧！

row.name: The Roach Hotel
row.detailed_description: Disclaimer:  Purchase of this base game includes the first chapter. Further chapters will be coming soon. The Roach Hotel is an analog horror game set inside a once beloved hotel, a paradise for guest to come stay and relax. Step into its halls brought to life with a retro PS1 inspired aesthetic and unsettling VHS style visuals. THE HOTEL STORY: Welcome to the Oxley Hotel, a resort that promises comfort to every guest. But behind its doors, the walls move when you’re not watching, and something stalks you in the shadows. Guided only by a note from your missing sister, you must uncover the truth, survive the lurking hallways, and escape the roaches crawling beneath the hotel. Search for your sister and uncover the secrets buried beneath the Oxley Hotel. Discover what truly began this nightmare, but only if you step inside. Are you brave enough? ARRIVAL IN THE HOTEL: EXPLORE: Wander the halls and uncover the unsettling secrets lurking within the hotel’s walls. Reveal the hidden truths buried within the hotel’s halls and discover behind the chaos. FLASHLIGHT : Use your trusted flash light to see in the dark halls of the hotel. Be careful in the dark, there might be roaches under your feet. HAMMER : This can come in handle to break things. Could also be useful to squish those big roaches. GRAVITYPAL : Use this tool to move heavier objects to solve puzzles. Solve puzzles to unlock rooms or power up failed generators in the hotel. Why is it so complicated for power? SECRETS Deep below the Hotel you could find easter eggs or back story lore behind the secrets of the hotel. So search every corner and clean every room to see what you can find. Just be careful for any jump scares.
row.short_description: The Roach Hotel is a first person analog horror game that drags you into its halls, where every shadow hides a question and every corner dares you to keep following its path.

row.name: Weabot
row.detailed_description: Dive into an environmental puzzle game where logic and exploration guide your every step. You play as a small flying drone with a unique ability: hacking into and taking control of other robots you encounter along the way. Each robot comes with different skills that you must use to overcome obstacles, activate mechanisms, and solve increasingly complex puzzles. This demo features 4 handcrafted levels , with the first one serving as a tutorial to introduce the core mechanics. The playtime ranges from 40 to 60 minutes , depending on how much you explore—those who dig deeper will also find hidden optional puzzles that expand the experience. Whether you aim straight for the goal or take your time uncovering every secret, each level is crafted to spark curiosity and creativity. Key Features Play as a flying drone with the ability to control other robots. Use each robot’s unique abilities to solve environmental puzzles. Explore 4 handcrafted levels , including a tutorial introduction. Find hidden optional puzzles for players who love to explore. Find all the chests and collectibles
row.short_description: Control a flying drone, possess other robots, and solve environmental puzzles in a mysterious world full of hidden challenges.

row.name: Split Racing
row.detailed_description: Split Racing blends time-attack racing with vehicle shooting . Your goal: finish before the timer expires . Destroy enemy cars or manage road hazards to survive—takedowns add time . Play solo (drive + shoot) or local split-screen co-op where one player drives and the other focuses on gunning. Key Features Genre : Arcade racing + shooting (time extension via takedowns) Core Loop : Tight timer → destroy enemies to gain time → manage the clock and clear Modes : Solo / Local 2-player split-screen (driver/gunner roles) Content : 4 tracks total (3 regular + 1 boss) Combat & Weapons Laser Beam : continuous fire for steady damage Charge Shot : high single-shot damage after charging Enemies & Hazards Gun-equipped enemy cars : patrol the road and shoot at the player; takedowns grant time Road hazards : stepping on them spawns chasing drones that pursue and attack Challenge Pillars Tight timer, enemy interference, drone pressure, racing line and firing-angle decisions Scope & Transparency Included : Solo, local split-screen co-op, 4 tracks, Laser Beam & Charge Shot Not Included : Online multiplayer, progression systems, deep customization, story-driven cutscenes
row.short_description: Arcade racing meets time-attack shooting. Fight off gun-wielding enemy cars and hazard-spawned chasing drones to earn extra time and finish the track. Solo or local 2-player co-op (driver/gunner split). 4 tracks, weapons: Laser Beam & Charge Shot.

row.name: The Predecessor
row.detailed_description: The Predecessor  is an atmospheric, surreal walking simulator. Traverse a series of abstract, ephemeral worlds. Interact with various strange characters and objects. Collect artifacts and memories scattered across the worlds. Follow the path of the one who came before you. This game engages in themes including the postmodern pastiche, artistic intent, and the presence of virtual spaces. Features Abstract and surreal environments to explore! Esoteric and silly characters who talk about things! Items which shed light on the world and its formation. Strong emphasis on narrative and atmosphere. A fairly short experience (1-2 hours). Worlds that will not last.
row.short_description: Exploration-focused walking simulator. Traverse abstract worlds. Interact with enigmatic characters. Collect memories from the one who came before you.
row.notes: Contains references to violence.

row.name: The Most Annoying Game Ever Playtest
The Mushroom Journal
row.detailed_description: You’ve moved to Mush Meadows to recover from burnout from the city and working life. By selling all your belongings, you set out to start a new life closer to nature and buy a cabin that has been abandoned for a while. You discover that the cabin used to belong to a mushroom enthusiast, and they left their basket and unfinished journal there, among other things. It almost looks like they’ve just disappeared and when browsing through the journal, you notice some pages missing or unfinished... Roam around the beautiful woodlands, find mushrooms, and use your Mushroom Journal to identify mushrooms by selecting the correct traits. Look for the characteristics of the cap, gills and stem, and remember: you may only pick mushrooms if you're 100% sure of them! The small community of Mush Meadows relies on the mushrooms for food, trade and medicine. They welcome you, and are eager to help you, it has been a long time since an “outsider” was among them. Go introduce yourself, and you might find yourself on a journey of new friendships, fulfilling the requests of your new neighbors. The Mushroom Journal was created as a student project within the duration of three months. We carefully crafted our concept, produced all art and audio for the game ourselves, and were able to deliver our project we're incredibly proud of. Alexandra ; art & animation Dániel János Simon ; game designer & audio designer Emilia Kurkela ; art, VFX & UI Sari Ala-Ukko ; level design, narrative writer & composer Tua Nylund ; programming & implementation
row.short_description: The Mushroom Journal is a Single-Player RPG, that takes you on an adventure to Mush Meadows. Mush Meadows is a mushroom-centered village, where you will have to help your neighbours by identifying and collecting them to uncover the mysteries that may lie under trading table.

row.name: Tackle Box: The First Catch
row.detailed_description: In Tackle Box , you play as John Tacklebox – a grizzled fisherman, quiet and stubborn as the sea itself. Your village has emptied over the years, leaving you alone with your memories, your rod, and the ocean. But when you enter a legendary fishing competition, the fight for survival begins. FISHING MEETS FIGHTING Catch fish. Fight fish. Win fights. Catch bigger fish. Repeat until your arms fall off. TIGHT, SIMPLE COMBAT Punch. Dodge. Block. Slam fish into the dirt. The controls are easy to learn and satisfying every time you land a hit. BOSS FISH WITH ATTITUDE Face a lineup of over-the-top fighters, each with their own moves and personality. Every boss has unique mechanics and a desire to ruin your day. Each boss has quotes guaranteed to make you question buying this game: “YOU WILL BE FISHED.” EXPLORE, CATCH, BRAWL Travel through lakes, rivers, and oceans to find new fish to fight and new ways to get beaten up by wildlife. Think you're the best angler in the valley? Prove it.
row.short_description: Tackle Box is a fast-paced fishing and fighting game where every catch wants to beat you up and drag you into the lake before you smack it with a rod. Cast your line, and get ready to throw hands with aquatic wildlife that absolutely did not evolve for peaceful coexistence.

ScrapBots
row.detailed_description: ScrapBots is a first-person melee brawler developed by a team of nine undergraduate game development students at the Savannah College of Art and Design (SCAD). Designed as our capstone project, our goal was to show off our strengths while learning and growing as game designers in the process. ScrapBots is set on an abandoned junk planet inhabited by ruthless robots tearing each other apart. The player takes control of a robot named Junk Dog, a hermit on a quest to defeat the leader of the most powerful faction in the wasteland. Use junk dogs’ unique function of interchangeable arms and other combat capabilities to help survive the savage bots of the wasteland. Fast First-Person Combat: Use both fists to box other bots into scrap. Take their left-over arms to fuel Junk dog’s rampage across the wasteland. Interchangeable Arms: Equip a variety of arms from Junk dog’s defeated enemies, each with unique punches and stats. Mix arms to find the best play style for the situation. Environmental Traps: Scattered across the wasteland are dangerous traps junk dog can leverage to speed up his killing. Movement abilities: Dash around the enemy to stay in the fight longer and help get across the wasteland terrain. Will you scrap your enemies or become scrap yourself?
row.short_description: Student Game Project- ScrapBots is a first person melee brawler where you venture through a forgotten, rusted trash planet and engage in hand-to-hand combat to fight for survival. Turn your enemies into scrap and repurpose their body parts to empower and augment your own combat abilities.

row.name: EcoBeat
row.detailed_description: EcoBeat is a rhythm-based plogging game where players clean the ocean by tapping to the beat. Set against a vibrant shoreline, EcoBeat turns environmental action into a stylized musical journey, combining the thrill of rhythm games with a mission to restore our oceans. 🌊 The Ocean Gives Us Oxygen Did you know that over 50% of the oxygen we breathe comes from the ocean? In EcoBeat, every piece of trash you collect helps regenerate marine life and boost oxygen levels. The more you clean, the more the sea heals, and the more rhythm you unlock. 🎵 Rhythm Meets Responsibility Inspired by OSU-style gameplay, players tap along to catchy beats as they collect trash swept along the tide. Time your taps perfectly to chain combos, earn points, and bring the ocean back to life. 🎮 Core Features Tap-to-the-beat rhythm gameplay with a unique ocean clean-up theme Immersive art and sound that reflect the health of the sea Playable without internet—anytime, anywhere Tracks that evolve with your progress—unlock new music and zones A peaceful but engaging gameplay experience that supports environmental awareness 🌱 Game With Purpose EcoBeat isn’t just about rhythm;it’s about rhythm with meaning. We believe small actions can lead to big change. Whether you’re a rhythm game pro or new to the genre, EcoBeat offers a joyful, healing way to play for the planet. Break the silence. Beat for the Earth. Clean the sea. One tap at a time.
row.short_description: Tap to the beat, clean the sea! Turn your rhythm into oxygen.

row.name: Around - The Game
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the Mansion. It’s Watching. In Around , you awaken inside a sprawling, decaying mansion that twists in impossible ways. Doors lead back to where you started, corridors stretch into darkness, and something is always just out of sight. Explore the shifting halls as you uncover forgotten memories, solve cryptic puzzles, and collect mysterious cherries—the only way to communicate with the ominous Fiend stalking the shadows. Speak carefully… the Fiend listens. But beware: the mansion is alive. It warps and twists the more you discover. The deeper you go, the harder it becomes to tell what’s real and what’s a trap. Key Features:  Atmospheric exploration of a haunted, shifting mansion  Unique puzzles that challenge perception and memory  A lurking presence that reacts to your actions  Use cherries to speak with the Fiend—or risk drawing its attention  Looping, reality-bending level design with psychological horror elements  Immersive sound design and whispers in the dark
row.short_description: Step into a haunted mansion where reality bends. Solve chilling puzzles, offer cherries to speak with the Fiend, and escape before you're consumed by the nightmare.

row.name: 토끼의 거짓말
row.detailed_description: 오늘 밤, 달토끼들과 함께하는 카드 배틀이 시작됩니다! 토끼의 거짓말 은 3인용 카드게임입니다. 자신의 패를 이용해 심리전을 걸어보세요. 자신의 패가 낮다고요? 걱정하실 필요 없습니다. 충분히 판을 뒤엎을 수 있으니까요! 토끼의 거짓말은 초보자도 쉽게 할 수 있는 카드게임입니다. 누구나 동등한 위치에서, 간단한 룰을 익히고 이기기 위해서 고민하고 또 고민해야 합니다. 당신은 심리전과 블러핑에 자신 있으신가요? 토끼의 거짓말의 특별한 룰! 기존의 카드게임들과 다른, 토끼의 거짓말에서만 즐길 수 있는 특별한 게임 규칙입니다. 자세한 내용은 인게임 룰북 을 참고해주세요! 친구와 함께 즐기는 토끼의 거짓말 [친구와 플레이] 버튼을 눌러, Steam 친구와 플레이할 수 있습니다. 블러핑과 거짓말이 난무하는 토끼들의 승부 속에서 색다른 재미를 느껴봅시다! 시작부터 심리전?! 게임을 시작하기 앞서 순서를 정하기 위한 가위바위보 가 진행됩니다. 여기서부터 토끼들의 심리전이 시작됩니다. 신중하게 선택합시다! 1vs1 스페셜 매치! 동점이 될 경우, 1vs1 스페셜 매치 가 진행됩니다. 느긋한 분위기의 게임은 순식간에 빠르고 긴장되는 매치로 변합니다! 귀여운 마스코트 - 달토끼 우리 게임의 마스코트, 달토끼들을 소개합니다! 덕구, 계순, 달래  세 친구들과 함께 카드게임을 승리로 이끌어 보아요! 귀여움에 사로잡혀 심리전을 해야한다는걸 잊어버리시면 곤란합니다! 토끼의 거짓말을 재미있게 즐겨주세요! 가위바위보, 카드 조합, 블러핑 으로 진행되는 귀엽지만 냉정한 토끼들의 승부! 친구나 동료와 함께, 토끼의 거짓말을 즐겨주세요! 과연 당신은 최강의 토끼가 될 수 있을까요?
row.short_description: Bunny's Lie is a real-time card game based on a moon rabbit in a Korean myth. Your luck doesn't matter in this match. You can win even if you don't have a good hand, if you just have wits and bluffing. Enjoy a fierce battle under the moonlight, with the cute bunnies. (ENG ver will be updated later.)
