row.name: Million Card Game
row.detailed_description: Million Card Game is a card game played between 1-5 players with the main objective being to be the first to get rid of all the cards in your hand! Place cards in the table either using same rank sandwiches of cards or runs of the same suit. Players are able to temporarily take cards from already placed groups on the table in order to make group in their hand allowing for dynamic and fun gameplay. The game features a tutorial. Single player bot mode and local multiplayer up to 5 players!
row.short_description: Compete with 1-5 players in this interactive cozy indie card game! Strategize table layouts and hand placement in order to be the first top win!

row.name: Perciflette
row.detailed_description: WELCOME, FUTURE HERO! Tired of grandma’s farm, you can sens it: time has come for you to set out on an adventure. You have no idea what you’ll find out there: incredible treasures, brave folks waiting for a hero to save them, epic quests revealing your courage, or something else … It’s up to you to discover it all… No matter what, move forward with caution and make the right choices… or start over! A TEXT-BASED ADVENTURE WHERE YOU LEARN FROM YOUR MISTAKES Perciflette is a die-and-retry game, so your (bad) choices will be fatal. No save, no checkpoint, stay focused, or you might end up missing grandma’s farm. And for the true adventurers hungry for glory : we even prepared some achievements just for you. WITH MUSIC BY ALEXANDER NAKARADA You’ll spend some time trying to reach the exit. So we needed music you never get tired of. And Alexander Nakarada’s work was exactly what we were looking for. A LITTLE BACKSTORY Perciflette was born 5 years ago during a Game Jam. In 3 days, we imagined the story, developed the mechanics, created the designs, and all of it formed this adventure. A few years later, we had the crazy idea to take the project all the way and publish it here.
row.short_description: Welcome, future hero! Perciflette is a narrative adventure with a simple goal : Find the way out. Explore, move forward with caution, and make the right choices…or start over!

row.name: Castle Femdom: Office Bot
row.detailed_description: Sold and delivered to the office of a business executive, you are to become her new personal AI robot assistant. She dislikes robots, so you must prove yourself useful if you want to survive. FEEL HER DOMINANCE She might not like robots, but she enjoys being in control. Can you learn to worship her as an obedient servant, or will you run out of battery before she 'forgets' to recharge them? FREE AND KINKY As a learning project towards bigger things (follow @somecastle), this game is free! Simply clean the office from dirt and keep track of your hand indicators (battery and relationship) to gradually unlock scenes with her. Domestic servitude Owner/property Humiliation Feet Face-sitting BECOME HER BOT  A simple high quality simulation of a cruel but gentle female domination experience. This short game is our first attempt at an immersive VR Femdom experience, with progression, gameplay, and physical simulations that matter. Remember that you can always quit the game if it makes you uncomfortable.
row.short_description: Satisfy your human 💃 owner as a robot 💀 assistant in this VR Femdom experience. Become her cog 👠 in the machine and learn your ♥️ place ♥️ as a cleaning and pleasure servant in an office 🏢 environment. Can you learn how to please your hot demonic boss?
row.notes: The game contains explicit sexual situations and nudity, as well as female domination kink play. Coercive sexual roleplay elements only target the first-person player character.

row.name: Humanoid
row.detailed_description: Your challenge in HUMANOID is to escape a robot factory, destroying as many robots as you can and taking out the controllers before they launch an attack on Earth. Run through the maze blasting robots, but don't touch the walls—they're electrified! The factory contains 81 rooms to explore as you search for keys that unlock new areas. Clearing a room powers you up for the next one, but leaving too many robots alive will spawn deadly rocket robots. Take too long in a room and a Controller Demon will appear to chase you out. HUMANOID is a parody sci-fi arcade-style run-and-gun shoot 'em up in the spirit of early 8-bit arcade games—with the added bonus that you can actually win. To survive, you need to play aggressively: you're rewarded for acting fast and clearing rooms. Simple to play, difficult to master. The path you take is up to you. Take the quickest route out or try to completely wipe out the Zylon menace. Learn the firing patterns of the Controller Bosses to take them down. Don't be a chicken - fight like a robot!!!
row.short_description: Humanoid is a parody sci-fi arcade-style run-and-gun shoot 'em up in the style of an early 8-bit arcade game—with the added bonus that you can actually win. row.name: ILL FLOS
row.detailed_description: Story “ILL FLOS” is a full-length RPG set in a fantasy world featuring the World Tree and magic. It follows the journey of Shaar, a young hunter whose job is to defeat monsters and protect people. Alongside his companions, he sets out to unravel the mystery of Insania, a flower that causes monsters to become violent. Eventually, he uncovers the truth hidden within the world. Overview Developed using RPG Maker VXAce, this is a 2D turn-based RPG. It features a system where SP earned by defeating enemies can be freely allocated to acquire skills. A key strategic element is the ability to freely swap party members during combat, expanding tactical possibilities. While there is only one main ending, multiple sub-events delve into the backgrounds of the colorful cast of companions, allowing players to freely enjoy the story. Features All background music (BGM) featured in the game is original, created exclusively for this title. A soundtrack containing every piece of music is also available. Regarding battles, a unique skill called “Timing Skill” exists. After activating a skill, there is a delay before it can be used again. Both allies and enemies can utilize this mechanic, creating battles where anticipation is key and strategic depth is paramount. Estimated Playtime 20 hours+ The concept is a well-paced play experience that can be enjoyed bit by bit in your spare time. The game is also designed so that players can experience all content within the game regardless of their playstyle. Translated with (free version)
row.short_description: A long-form fantasy RPG with turn-based battles, beginning with the legend of the god dwelling in the World Tree and its conflict with humankind.

row.name: Grove of the Felled Olives
row.detailed_description: Grove of the Felled Olives is a virtual memorial dedicated to the humans killed in Gaza between Oct '23 and July '25. This is the desktop version of the memorial. It is presented here as an offline experience for greater accessibility and fidelity. No such physical memorial recognizing each individual exists as of yet. Pay respects to each of the over 60,000 departed in a peaceful refuge for their memory. Come back at any point to pick up where you left off - every session in the grove begins at a new location. The grove includes a single memorial for the countless lives that remain unaccounted for. I made this memorial to humanize the statistics and provide an accessible experience for people across the world to honor those lost. I hope this can be a respectful place for loved ones and strangers alike to reflect on our shared humanity. May we learn one day to be better. -Nick Oueijan (a human being) The experience is simple yet powerful Walk through a peaceful virtual memorial Approach each of over 60,000 monuments to acknowledge the identity of the real people who they commemorate Move at your own pace Contemplate life, humanity, family, love, responsibility, scale, loss.... With atmospheric original music by Test Collage Data last updated on July 31st, 2025   Due to the limitations of ensuring the in-browser version of the memorial continues to smoothly on most mobile devices, this offline desktop version contains more up to date data . Data from Gaza's Ministry of Health provided by Tech for Palestine. I am but one person - if you encounter any technical issues, let me know and I'll do my best to resolve them.
row.short_description: Grove of the Felled Olives is a free virtual memorial dedicated to the over 60,000 humans killed in Gaza between Oct '23 and July '25. Pay respects to each of the departed in a peaceful refuge for their memory.

row.name: Hello my World! Lily.
row.detailed_description: Description: In this visual novel, the protagonist is a programmer named Alexey, whose life is drowning in the gray routine of loneliness. Tired of the endless monotony, he imagines an ideal girl, Lily, and immerses himself with her in the illusory world of a sanatorium. But over time, these fantasies expand beyond mere dreams, blurring the boundaries between reality and illusion. A story about internal conflict and the search for harmony with oneself! Game Features: A rare Tulpa game. Two main characters in the story: Alex, Lily Kinetic story. A short, captivating story (approximately 2 hours to complete). Visual style of old novels. Scriptwriter: Kket. Artists: heartwarming sprites by ppipiduster, mesmerizing dove art by luos_arts, CG art by Black on White and deathwarr. Russian voice actors by Anijoy: Alexey is Evgeny Valdanov (ShadowWarrior), and Lily is Elizaveta Dobrovolskaya (jujlu). Composers: atmospheric music by That Guy From 2015 and mc.dummy.
row.short_description: 'Hello my World! Lily.' is a visual novel about a programmer who finds an unusual way to cope with loneliness and routine. But after a while, his imagination and actions go too far, and the line between reality and fantasy begins to melt rapidly.
row.notes: The game contains discussions of sexual activity, references to alcohol consumption, and partial nudity.

row.name: Starbrew Station
row.detailed_description: Your production quota awaits. In Starbrew Station, you're the operations manager of a remote coffee production outpost on the edge of known space. One rickety brewing machine. Zero workers. Can you scale this operation into a galaxy-supplying caffeine empire? SCALE YOUR OPERATION Start by manually brewing your first few coffees, then recruit a quirky crew of 33 unique alien workers to automate every step of your operation. Baristas brew the coffee. Technicians install machines. Traders generate passive income. Support units boost production. Fighters defend your station. Expand across 6 visually distinct decks : the industrial Engineering bay, the lush Hydroponics garden, the plasma-powered Reactor level, the exclusive VIP lounge, and the Administrative command deck. Each new deck unlocks more powerful units and multiplies your entire station's output. MAXIMIZE OUTPUT Active management pays off. Every 8 minutes, the station enters Rush Hour . For 45 seconds, all machines run at infinite capacity and your earnings double. Watch ships fly past your station as you capitalize on the surge. When your output is high enough, face one of 8 randomized Galactic Inspector variants in a unique boss fight. Deploy your fighter units, click frantically, and prove your station is worthy of prestige. PRESTIGE AND MASTER YOUR PLAYSTYLE Defeat the Inspector, reset your run, and earn Prestige Tokens . But this isn't just 'buy upgrades in order.' It's about building YOUR strategy. Choose Your Mastery Path: Automation Mastery - Boost trader income, technician speed, and offline production Active Mastery - Enhance rewards, frozen aliens, morale, and rush duration Combat Mastery - Increase fighter damage, shrine power, and boss click damage Chase Long-Term Milestones: 7 prestige milestones (at prestiges 3, 5, 10, 15, 25, 50, and 100) unlock permanent bonuses: extra tokens per run, new modifiers, the challenge system, and exclusive cosmetics. Take On Optional Challenges: After Prestige 15, activate up to 2 challenges per run for bonus tokens. Complete a prestige in under 15 minutes. Beat the boss without shrines. Use only traders. Risk versus reward. DEEP PROGRESSION SYSTEMS Prestige tokens are just the beginning. Multiple progression layers work together to create weeks of meaningful growth: R&D Wing - Allocate income to unlock 17 permanent quality-of-life and power upgrades Unit Specialization - Level up workers and choose between two unique upgrade paths per unit type Deck Synergies - Unlock cross-deck bonuses that keep early content relevant in late game Shrines - Enhance your fighters with damage, speed, and critical hit bonuses Achievement Buffs - 22 achievements grant unique permanent bonuses to production, clicks, and more Daily Streaks - Claim rewards daily with multipliers up to 4x Chase the ultimate goal: amass enough tokens to unlock the legendary Golden Barista , a unit that will transform your output forever. ROGUELIKE VARIETY Each prestige run features random modifiers , one positive and one negative, that change your strategy. Production Surge or Economic Crunch? Rush Hour Boost or Slow Start? No two runs feel identical, and smart players adapt their approach. TAKE A BREAK Step away from the production floor with unlockable bonus minigames : Basketball - Aim and shoot for high scores Pachinko - Drop balls and watch chaos unfold Botanical Garden - Grow and harvest plants for rewards Decorate your station with 25+ unique decorations themed to each deck. Make your outpost your own. GUIDED BY ARIA Your station AI, ARIA, walks you through every system with dark humor and dynamic expressions . She'll celebrate your victories, mock your failures, and make sure you never feel lost, even when the Inspector is breathing down your neck. BUILT FOR EVERYONE Streamers: Optional Twitch integration displays viewer names on your units and rewards chat activity. Accessibility: Full support for 28 languages, colorblind modes, controller navigation, camera shake toggle, and multiple number notation formats. Premium Polish: Bloom effects, ambient cosmic particles, screen shake feedback, and smooth UI transitions create a satisfying, polished experience. Fair and Complete: Starbrew Station is 100% free-to-play and designed to be completed without spending money. Optional cosmetic DLC and a few balanced gameplay units are available for players who wish to support development.
row.short_description: Build the galaxy's most efficient coffee production outpost in this sci-fi idle game. Recruit 33 unique alien workers, automate operations across 6 industrial decks, and push your station to the limit during Rush Hour surges. Prestige and expand through multiple progression systems.

row.name: OPEN YOUR EYES
row.detailed_description: OPEN YOUR EYES is a grid-based puzzle game about perception, logic, and discovery. Each level challenges you to open every eye on the board, but the rules change as new eyes are introduced. Some eyes open with a simple click, while others react to lasers, electricity, or the passage of time. To succeed, you must think ahead, manipulate interactions, and plan your moves with precision. Across 19 handcrafted levels, new mechanics are layered in to create increasingly complex puzzles. Clear each stage in the fewest possible moves to earn top ranks, and test how clearly you can see the solution. With its neon glow and surreal eye motifs, OPEN YOUR EYES offers a puzzle experience that is both logical and dreamlike. 19 handcrafted levels with escalating complexity 7 unique eye types , each with distinct rules and interactions Additional objects like redirectors to manipulate puzzle flow Ranking system (C to S) rewarding efficiency and intentional play A surreal neon aesthetic blending mysticism and minimalism 'This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.'
row.short_description: Fix your gaze on this grid-based puzzle game as you progress through levels by opening every eye. Discover eyes of different styles and properties and earn top ranks by focusing your vision and clearing stages with the least possible moves.

row.name: If you’re a man, hold on for half a song
row.detailed_description: Are you a man? If you are, hold on for the duration of half a song! In this game, players will play as a small square, dodging and defeating enemies within half a song’s time. As the difficulty increases, the excitement also increases! Feel free to take on the challenge! Game features: Simple yet smooth controls Awesome special effects 3 difficulty levels to suit all types of players 3 distinctively styled artifact weapons and 12 artifact accessories for you to mix and match The songs in the game are really catchy! Play the game while listening to the music Author's note: This is my first project while learning the Godot engine. I wanted to challenge myself to create a small game using mostly Godot's built-in assets. This game is free, and I hope everyone can show more support and come to love it.
row.short_description: This is an action shooter with extremely simple controls.Its gameplay duration is short but concise, with no filler content at all.The levels seem simple yet hide subtle twists, and there are plenty of little surprises waiting for you to discover!Anyway, it’s free—you can’t go wrong with it.

row.name: 精神寄生
row.detailed_description: 你剛從完全潛行遊戲《新世界》中登出下線 但不知道發生了什麼BUG，回過神來發現你的意識下載到一個陌生人 周雲成 身上 幸好對方很熱心幫你解決找回身體的問題 不過萬萬沒想到，你們將捲入一場史無前例的AI資安前哨戰中...... -------------- ※※This game currently only supports Traditional Chinese . Compatibility with non-Traditional Chinese regions is not guaranteed. We apologize for any inconvenience caused to players in non-Traditional Chinese regions. If you encounter the error message '???? ANSI ???? Unicode ???' or 'Unable to convert ANSI to Unicode encoding',  please see the [Troubleshooting] section below. ※本遊戲劇情為虛構的短篇小說，與任何現實人事時地物皆無關連，如有雷同純屬巧合 ※本遊戲含有少量驚嚇展現，部分情節可能引起玩家不適，如果無法接受，請直接關閉遊戲或不建議下載遊玩 ※為了強化劇情沉浸感，會請玩家取一個1~10個字以內的名稱 ※遊戲中包含分歧結局，僅取決於最後一個劇情很明顯的關鍵分歧點上，且並 沒有 好感度設定 ※遊戲中包含一些略硬核(掰的)知識說明，如果沒興趣可以大膽地選【我不想知道】，不影響結局 ※所有遊戲內容完全允許實況和錄影，包含結局特典和附錄，喜歡的話歡迎分享 ※什麼？你沒時間或不方便玩遊戲？本遊戲壓縮檔另外附小說版可供閱讀(.pdf 和 .epub)，可以放在手機上帶著走，內文90%相同，只差在沒有特典追加內容 ※隨遊戲附上的兩個投影片檔案(.pdf 和 .odp)，算是彩蛋之一，也允許實況和錄影，不過為避免劇透，建議玩完才看 -------------- ●畫面尺寸：1280 x 720 ●遊戲版本：1.7 ●遊戲時間：大約1~2小時 ●風格：科幻、懸疑、資安 ●作者/程式：阿禾 ●美術：艾登、阿禾 -------------- 大家好，我是阿禾，業餘興趣之一是寫網路小說 在構思此作品的劇情時，由於題材有些特殊，靈機一動想挑戰做成小品視覺小說遊戲，於是有了此作品《精神寄生》 因篇幅較短，且以分享興趣為主，本作品將堅持以免費方式發布，希望大家當作輕鬆殺時間的小故事來看 故事劇情探討假設在近未來，AI技術發達到可以直接連接腦波的時代，有可能碰上的潛在資安風險 以及聚焦在某個在不為人知的角落，默默為公眾安全貢獻的小角色 玩家扮演的是一個因遊戲BUG，意外寄生在主角身上的意識，以此開始的輕懸疑科幻劇 劇情大多數時候處在' 雙重第一人稱 '視角，且'玩家無法操作主角' 因此挑戰製作成視覺小說遊戲而非RPG，試圖強化沉浸感 由於小弟的美術能力實在是死穴，此作品使用了不少免費素材，部分背景圖使用AI繪製，再額外盡力修圖 (所有詳細素材清單都寫在readme.txt) 本作登場人物稀少，絕大多數劇情都處在看不到其他人的情境 在看不到人的場景，盡量讓背景中的小物件產生變化，來填補'看到的'視角，以及添加一些力所能及的小細節 更多的重心還是回到劇本本身，竭盡所能希望能夠把故事說好 或甚至是......正因為素材極簡化，反而更能詮釋劇中的核心意象？ (目前已經付費請繪師幫忙繪製少量立繪中，由於對方近期有事要忙，而本人推估對遊戲劇情影響不大 為減少繪師時間壓力，協議後決定交付必要道具素材圖後，先發布此遊戲，後續待立繪補齊，會再行更新) 若您對遊戲劇情有興趣，且不在意可能不夠精緻的美術的話，還請容小弟獻醜了🙏 如果願意的話，希望您玩完或讀完後可以留下心得感想 -------------- PS. 劇情中提供的某段虛構演算法，如果能對現實資安研究提供思路和幫助的話，歡迎將附錄的投影片檔案取走，不必署名 這個故事略帶一點寓言和公益性質，這也是我堅持免費發佈的原因之一，只要能引起更多人關注到未來的潛在風險就算值了 -------------- [Troubleshooting] If you encounter an error message '???? ANSI ???? Set it to Off, restart your computer, and launch the game. ●Windows 11: Control Panel > Time & Language > Region & Language > Windows Display Language (unfold) > Early Access (Beta): Use Unicode UTF-8 for global language support Off [　] On Set it to Off, restart your computer, and launch the game.
row.short_description: You are a player who has just logged out of the VR MMORPG “NEW World.” Suddenly, your mind is downloaded into a stranger named 周雲成. Luckily, he may help you reclaim your body—but you never expected to be drawn into the first clash of an unprecedented AI security war.

row.name: Tai Chi USA
row.detailed_description: This app has 9 energy postures which simplify tai chi. You can do it sitting, standing, stepping, or lying down just listening to relax. Every 30 seconds a new posture is presented by the avatar which looks like George Washington. You do the posture, relax, then get ready for the next posture. The app helps your balance, strength, posture, and energy flow.  There are also some other meditations and videos which go along with the main movement meditation and enhance your experience using the main movement meditation feature of the app.
row.short_description: This is a simplified version of Tai Chi more fit for American people than traditional Tai Chi, which is more attuned to the Asian mind. Instead of Peng, Lu, Ji, and An as the four main energies, they are Water, Wind, Fire, and Ground/Earth. There is a quick calm mode, where you can just listen.

row.name: Jurassic Wrap
row.detailed_description: Step back into the prehistoric age for a short, light-hearted rescue mission! In Jurassic Wrap, your goal is simple: save the baby dinosaur eggs and make it safely to the exit portal. Along the way you’ll leap, dodge, and use clever screen-wrapping mechanics to outsmart threats and discover new ways through each level. This isn’t about fighting dinosaurs — it’s about protecting them! With colourful visuals, approachable gameplay, and just the right amount of danger, Jurassic Wrap is fun for kids, families, and anyone who loves classic arcade-style platformers. Features: 🥚 Rescue the Eggs – Collect baby dinosaur eggs to complete each level. 🔄 Screen-Wrap Gameplay – Walk off one side of the screen and pop back on the other! 🦖 Face Prehistoric Dangers – Avoid hazards and threats while finding the exit. 👨‍👦 Made by a Father & Son Duo – A unique project created with love and heart. 🎮 Family-Friendly Fun – Easy to play, fun to master, and safe for kids. 🌍 Classic Arcade Vibes – Simple controls, colourful visuals, and timeless gameplay.
row.short_description: Rescue baby dino eggs in a family-friendly adventure made by a father & son duo. In Jurassic Wrap, your goal is simple: save the baby dino eggs and make it safely to the exit portal. Along the way you’ll leap, dodge, and use clever screen-wrapping mechanics to outsmart threats through each level.

row.name: Space Evolver
row.detailed_description: Space Evolver is a roguelite management and genetics game that incorporates real-time strategy elements. Upgrade your spaceship and technologies, complete missions, purchase packs, and guide the evolution of species according to mission requirements. Key Features: Innovative Breeding System: Creatures choose who to reproduce with (even with enemy creatures). Try to make them choose who you want (inbreeding may occur). Visual style: 2.5D isometric pixel art style with characters that have 8-way animations. Diferents Creatures: More than 10 different types of creatures, with different stats and qualities. All in Real-Time: The game has an isometric layout, with a tile-based system. But unlike other similar games, it's not turn-based. Everything happens at the same instant, in real time. Dynamic environment in constant evolution: There will be events that alter the environment and the creatures. Progression system: You'll earn resources upon completing each mission; use them to upgrade different systems. This way, you'll be able to complete the next mission with less difficulty and/or take on more complex missions.
row.short_description: Space Evolver is a roguelite management and genetics game that incorporates real-time strategy game elements. Upgrade your spaceship and technologies, complete missions, and guide the evolution of species.

row.name: 时光传奇
row.detailed_description: 游戏介绍 一、 核心概念✨ 全新传奇《时光传奇》，耗时两年精心雕琢，倾尽心血打造诚意巨献🎉！以原创剧情为灵魂的基础上，它保留了传奇的核心玩法（打怪👊、升级🆙、爆装备💥、攻沙巴克🏰）超级大陆为舞台🌏，秉持“不肝不氪”的友好理念🥰，同时增加了神器、专属装备等独具特色的新内容，让游戏体验既怀旧又新奇。该版本节奏快，爆率高，开局就送(高级技能📜、典藏称号🏆、大量货币💰)让你升级迅猛，材料易得，PK更爽快，主打一个“爽”字，为玩家开启一场别具一格的传奇冒险之旅🚀！！！ 二、游戏攻略🔥 起步资金与低投入策略 开服第一时间进游戏快速升级，建议充完10元的首充礼包🎁，(背包专属、时装专属、地图传送、以及大量材料货币)，打怪可免费升级会员特权，大幅度提升人物属性，快速抢占终极BOSS👾 升级与任务 在游戏初期，跟随主线任务走是最有效的升级方式🛣️。过程中可以通过使用经验丹快速提升角色等级，继续做主线任务和每日挑战任务💪、悬赏任务等，能迅速提升角色的实力和获得更多的资源📦。 地图选择 适合平民玩家的地图✅ 对于零氪玩家来说，可以选择等级和专属地图🗺️，这些地图里的BOSS掉落物丰富且挑战难度适中，会比较适合平民玩家。 适合高充值玩家的地图✅ 对于氪金玩家，建议挑战日充和累充地图💎，这些地图则分布着大量boss，可获得大量资源，相较于其他普通地图可爆出专属，神器，材料的概率较高，优先建议选择日充和累充地图打怪👾 三、快速提升战力⚔️ 一开始可以选择优先对转生，称号，打野刀进行升级🛠️ 中间可以选择优先合成一套符文会有额外属性加成，其次可以对转生，称号，剑甲，通天宝鉴，技能，五行等进行升级，可以大幅度提高属性💪 最后可以通过锻造高阶印记，升级四象，对符文进行强化，对斗笠和盾牌进行升级，完成剧情任务获得高阶称号等等，更多功能等你来探！！！🔍 四、游戏活动🎯 新服活动 新区跑酷：在盟重土城安全区跑动即可获得随机奖励🏃‍♂️！！！ 经验暴涨：享受泡点经验，更有元宝每秒暴涨💰！！！ 天降财宝：活动坐标散落大量财宝💎！！！ 神器降世：击杀怪物，此怪必出高级神兵，助力英雄起步🗡️！！！ 日常活动 世界BOSS:地图随机刷新红包卷🧧 激情战场：每秒涨灵符🔖 沙城魔王：沙巴克复活点刷新1只沙城魔王👹 五、 总结🚀 《时光传奇》版本是一款极具想象力的创新玩法，传奇的PVP核心与社交体系（沙巴克攻城🏰、行会战🛡️）成长感与爆发力的基础上，以创新的龙魂境界体系和深度成长玩法，深度玩法满足追求极致需求，为玩家开启了在熟悉世界中追求至高力量的崭新征途🛤️，是每位热爱传奇的玩家不容错过的革新之作。

row.name: Project Homecoming Haven
row.detailed_description: A Toge Greenhouse Project Project Homecoming Haven was created during Toge Greenhouse 2023, an internal game jam held by Toge Productions to create new, innovative, and experimental games. This is a short playable rendition of the game with the intention to blossom the idea within a relatively short development time. Project Homecoming Haven At Your Service “We know how hard it is, to see your beloved ones leave. To see the room they’ve left, their space without their presence. You don’t have to face the grief alone. We can help you. With Homecoming Haven Trauma Cleaners, we can help you clean up rooms full of memories too painful to look at and save you from the grief of facing the space initially left by your loved ones. You don’t have to face everything by yourself. Let us help you.” The Gameplay Play as a Trauma Cleaner; a housecleaning service that receives requests from bereaving families to clean up rooms and houses left by the deceased.  In your job, you will learn about those who left the world of their own volition or others. Learn about the life they lived, choose belongings of the deceased to be given to their families, or keep them for yourself to grow your Trauma Cleaning business. Uncover Hidden Stories The environment of each home tells a unique story about the homeowner's life and experiences. Items Reveal Stories Items found in the homes provide further insights into the homeowners' lives and relationships. Choices Affect Storytelling Players' decisions regarding give or kept items can influence the storytelling and reveal additional narrative elements. Control Info
row.short_description: Embark on a heartwarming journey as a home cleaning specialist.

row.name: Project KILLDANCE
row.detailed_description: A Toge Greenhouse Project Project KILLDANCE was created during Toge Greenhouse 2023, an internal game jam held by Toge Productions to create new, innovative, and experimental games. Become the spectral death A Noir tactical action game featuring a one-army strategy and instant-death combat. Slowly observe your surroundings, choreograph each killing move, finish your mission, and leave no survivors. Features Plan your movement and perform your attack cards to clear each stage. Time is frozen in between your actions, use this opportunity to dodge bullets, take cover, and kill enemies effectively. Draft new cards to learn new skills and adapt to your missions. Once you complete your mission, replay your performance and watch your KILLDANCE.
row.short_description: Project KILLDANCE is a Noir tactical action featuring a one-army strategy and instant-death combat. Slowly observe surroundings, choreograph each killing move, leave no survivor, and become the spectral death.

row.name: Party Party Anxiety!
row.detailed_description: A Toge Greenhouse Project Party Party Anxiety! was created during Toge Greenhouse 2023, an internal game jam held by Toge Productions to create new, innovative, and experimental games. Anxiety at the Party Step into the shoes of a person battling social anxiety at a prom party. Meet people and play your cards correctly to respond to their conversation. Play the correct cards to establish relationships or play them wrong and everything will become scarier and haunt your social anxiety even more. Play cards to strike conversation Use conversation cue cards up your sleeves to make connections. Identify and follow your conversation partner's interests. Play card combos to better match the flow and gain the best compatibility rating! Feel the horror of talking to people But beware, you only have so much opportunity to strike the best conversation. Play your cards wrong and your partner might haunt your anxiety even more. Maybe it's all in your head. Manage and play your cards correctly, and if you can pull through, maybe it's all just in your head and people aren't that scary after all :)
row.short_description: A dating card game for anxious people. Use conversation cue cards up your sleeves to make connections. But beware—the more anxious you get, the scarier they become.

row.name: 큐트 여전사 3 (Cute Warrior Girl 3)
row.detailed_description: 🏹 Game Overview Although this is an indie game, it features 100% full Korean voice acting . Cute Warrior Girl 3 is a single-player RPG that combines comedy and fantasy elements. Players take on the role of Fiora , a cute and brave warrior on a journey to protect her village. The game maintains the humorous tone and simple controls of the previous title while adopting a traditional JRPG style. It offers more events and character interactions, delivering a short but focused gameplay experience full of exploration, battles, and comedic scenes. 🧭 Story A strange orc army suddenly appears in a peaceful village. Cute warrior Fiora sets out on a journey, exploring dangerous areas, meeting various NPCs, and advancing toward the orcs’ stronghold. Unexpected and funny events await the player along the way. Your ultimate goal is to gather information and combat techniques by talking to NPCs, earn GOLD through various events, buy and equip all gear, and defeat the orcs to protect the kingdom’s peace. Can Fiora defeat the orcs? ⚔️ Key Features 🕹️ Simple controls and turn-based combat: Easy and accessible for beginners 🌿 Light exploration and interaction: Events occur in villages, forests, bathhouses, and more 🎭 Comedic presentation: Cute SD characters and humorous situational scenes 🧍‍♀️ Charming protagonist Fiora: Improved illustrations, expressions, and costumes 🕰️ Short and focused gameplay: Approximately 30 minutes to complete 🎧 BGM & Voice Acting: 100% Korean voice acting and subtitles (currently only Korean supported) 👉 If more than 3 requests for English support are made in the game’s review section, English subtitles will be added. 🧭 Controls Move: Arrow Keys (↑ ↓ ← →) Interact: Spacebar Run: Left Shift Key
row.short_description: This is the adventure story of Fiora, the 21-year-old cute warrior girl. A sexy comedy JRPG where you explore the forest, talk with people to gather information about the orcs, and journey to their stronghold to defeat them!

row.name: 怪異ジャッジ・ドリーミー
row.detailed_description: 怪異の正体を２択でジャッジ！ 怪異の正体は「元人間」か「ホンモノの怪異」か… ギリギリまでヒントを得て2択でジャッジ！ 正体のヒントを得るたびに、主人公の理性が減り、様子がおかしくなっていき… ※ちょっぴり不穏な演出が含まれます！ ※メカクレ青年の目出しはありません！ 形式・プレイ時間 登場する怪異は８体！ 【メイン5体】+【ヒミツの怪異3】 ★１エピソードで5分くらいでサクッと楽しめます！（怪異１体＝１エピソード） ★それぞれの怪異に３エンド（成功・失敗・タイムオーバー）があります！ ★どこからでも遊べるオムニバス形式で、はじめて遊ぶ方にもおすすめ！ 実況・二次創作など 実況・ファンアート、コメント大歓迎です！大変励みになります！ ★実況内で全てのエンドを見たり、「ヒミツの怪異」にチャレンジするのも大歓迎です！ ★コメントやファンアートで「怪異の正体のネタバレ」「ヒミツの怪異の名前や姿のネタバレ」が含まれる場合は、ワンクッション入れていただけますと幸いです！（実況ではネタバレが前提なので、そのまま出してOKです！） クレジット 制作ツール：ティラノビルダー 効果音：★効果音ラボ様　★OtoLogic様(CC BY 4.0) 実写の写真素材：★フリー素材ぱくたそ 様 スペシャルサンクス：リコペマの妹
row.short_description: とびきりファンシーな怪異調査ノベルゲーム短編集！ メカクレ青年ハマメが、夢のような不思議な世界へ！

row.name: Rewoven Self
row.detailed_description: Rewoven Self is a dual-perspective narrative puzzle game that combines first-person interaction with 2.5D platform exploration . You move between two connected spaces — reality and fantasy. Actions in the real world, such as folding, cutting, and stitching, influence the journey of the paper figure in the fantasy world, gradually guiding the protagonist toward emotional repair and self-growth. The story unfolds across three chapters, following the arc of Escape – Collapse – Reweaving: Chapter I – “Escape into Fantasy” You build a personal fantasy world through folding — hiding emotions inside a paper-shaped space and using imagination to resist the loneliness of the real room. Chapter II – “Reality Cages Cage” The fantasy starts to fall apart. Caught between ideals and reality, the protagonist reaches the edge of emotional breakdown. Chapter III – “Fantasy & Reality Reweaving” You stitch the two worlds back together. While repairing emotions, you also face choices and actions in reality — no longer escaping, but moving forward with fantasy as part of yourself. The game focuses on non-combat puzzles, combining side-scrolling platforming with first-person real-world interactions to portray an emotional journey from escape → struggle → reweaving. Developer’s Note I want players to feel the weight of emotion through interaction, not just watch it. Rewoven Self is a journey from fantasy to reality, from avoidance to integration. Using folding to build a fragile refuge, cutting to break through what holds you back, and stitching to reconnect everything into a whole. For me, this game is more than a project — it is a process of understanding, repairing, and starting again. When you walk out of that final door, I hope you carry your own sense of wholeness and reweave the world in your own way. Contact Email : tangyuanyuan0329@163.com

row.detailed_description: Shield a frozen Brasília from relentless hordes marching across the city’s landmarks. In Brasília Defense , a strategic tower defense, every choice matters: place towers, deploy heroes, manage resources, and swing the battle with well-timed special powers. Face escalating waves across maps inspired by Brasília’s regions , reimagined in a glacial setting full of atmosphere and detail. Mix tower types, upgrades, and hero abilities to craft unique defenses and adapt your strategy to each mission. What to expect 5 selectable heroes with distinct combat styles and abilities that synergize with your towers. Upgradeable towers to build, evolve, and create powerful synergies that hold the line. 3 clutch specials : call dragons , meteors , and mercenaries to turn the tide when it matters most. Many enemy types with varied behaviors and resistances— watch out for fliers! 8 thematic maps set in a glacial Brasília , paired with an original soundtrack to heighten the action. Why you’ll like it Personality-driven strategy : powers, and upgrade paths enable multiple answers to the same challenge. Rising challenge curve : scaling waves reward planning, timing, and smart countermeasures. Immersive audiovisuals : handcrafted environments and an original score deliver epic defensive battles. Awards & recognition Selected by the Lei Paulo Gustavo – DF cultural grant. Ready your defenses, rally your heroes, and prove that the chill of the high plains is no match for sharp strategy. Brasília Defense awaits on the battlefield.
